1.0.s:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ..
śrīnārāyaṇāya namaḥ ..
atha śrīviṣṇudharmottaraprārambhaḥ ..
1.0.d:
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीनारायणाय नमः ॥
अथ श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरप्रारम्भः ॥
1.0.m:
Homage to holy Gaṇeśa.
Homage to holy Nārāyaṇa.
Now begins the holy Viṣṇudharmottara.

1.1.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet .. 1 ..
1.1.d:
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ॥
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
1.1.m: Bowing to Nārāyaṇa and to Nara, the best of men, / and to goddess Sarasvatī and Vyāsa, one should then utter "Victory!"

1.1.s:
kṛtavarmā tathā bhojaḥ śveto māhiṣmatīpatiḥ ..
kulindaḥ sarvadamano mālaviścandravarddhanaḥ .. 2 ..
1.1.d:
कृतवर्मा तथा भोजः श्वेतो माहिष्मतीपतिः ॥
कुलिन्दः सर्वदमनो मालविश्चन्द्रवर्द्धनः ॥ 2 ॥
1.1.m: Kṛtavarman and Bhoja, Śveta the lord of Māhiṣmatī, / Kulinda, Sarvadamana, Mālavi, Candravardhana,

1.1.s:
vatsanābhaśca bāṇaśca nandīśo darasatpatiḥ ..
pratisāraścitradhanussarvo vāyurathastathā .. 3 ..
1.1.d:
वत्सनाभश्च बाणश्च नन्दीशो दरसत्पतिः ॥
प्रतिसारश्चित्रधनुस्सर्वो वायुरथस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
1.1.m: Vatsanābha and Bāṇa, Nandīśa the king of Darasa, / Pratisāra, Citradhanus, Sarva, and Vāyuratha,

1.1.s:
draviḍaḥ kusumāpīḍa otraśca samarapriyaḥ ..
śambhuḥ kirātarājaśca auraso nandivardhanaḥ .. 4 ..
1.1.d:
द्रविडः कुसुमापीड ओत्रश्च समरप्रियः ॥
शम्भुः किरातराजश्च औरसो नन्दिवर्धनः ॥ 4 ॥
1.1.m: Draviḍa, Kusumāpīḍa, Otra, beloved in battle, / Śambhu the Kirāta king, Aurasa, Nandivardhana,

1.1.s:
vaṭumūlaśca tūneśaḥ śālvaśca janamejayaḥ ..
suhyarājo dadhīkarṇo bāhlīko damanastathā .. 5 ..
1.1.d:
वटुमूलश्च तूनेशः शाल्वश्च जनमेजयः ॥
सुह्यराजो दधीकर्णो बाह्लीको दमनस्तथा ॥ 5 ॥
1.1.m: Vaṭumūla and the ruler of Tūna, Śālva, Janamejaya, / the king of Suhmas, Dadhīkarṇa, Bāhlīka, and Damana,

1.1.s:
hiraṇyanābhaḥ kausalyo dāśārho vijayastathā..
ete cānye ca rājānaḥ śataśo bahudakṣiṇāḥ .. 6 ..
1.1.d:
हिरण्यनाभः कौसल्यो दाशार्हो विजयस्तथा॥
एते चान्ये च राजानः शतशो बहुदक्षिणाः ॥ 6 ॥
1.1.m: Hiraṇyanābha, Kausalya, Dāśārha, and Vijaya — / these and other kings by the hundreds, lavish with sacrificial fees,

1.1.s:
sampūrṇacandravadanā gajarājakaroravaḥ ..
upāsāṃcakrire vajraṃ sihāsanagatā nṛpāḥ .. 7 ..
1.1.d:
सम्पूर्णचन्द्रवदना गजराजकरोरवः ॥
उपासांचक्रिरे वज्रं सिहासनगता नृपाः ॥ 7 ॥
1.1.m: with faces like the full moon and thighs like the trunks of royal elephants, / kings seated upon their thrones, attended upon Vajra.

1.1.s:
bahubhirbhūmipālaiśca tathā vajreṇa dhīmatā ..
yudhiṣṭhireṇa ca sadā śobhitā śuśubhe sabhā ..8..
1.1.d:
बहुभिर्भूमिपालैश्च तथा वज्रेण धीमता ॥
युधिष्ठिरेण च सदा शोभिता शुशुभे सभा ॥8॥
1.1.m: Adorned by many rulers of the earth, by wise Vajra, / and ever by Yudhiṣṭhira, the assembly shone bright.

1.1.s:
rājānaste tato dṛṣṭvā ṛṣīndurlabhadarśanān..
brahmalokasthamātmānamamanyanta yaśobhṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
1.1.d:
राजानस्ते ततो दृष्ट्वा ऋषीन्दुर्लभदर्शनान्॥
ब्रह्मलोकस्थमात्मानममन्यन्त यशोभृतः ॥ 9 ॥
1.1.m: Seeing then the sages, whose sight is rare to obtain, / those kings, bearers of renown, thought themselves to be in the world of Brahmā.

1.1.s:
ūcuste praṇayādvākyaṃ vajraṃ bhūrisahasradam ..
yathā tretāyuge rājandvāpare ca yathā nṛpāḥ ..
brāhmaṇā brahmakalpāśca tathaiva susamāgatāḥ .. 1.1.10 ..
1.1.d:
ऊचुस्ते प्रणयाद्वाक्यं वज्रं भूरिसहस्रदम् ॥
यथा त्रेतायुगे राजन्द्वापरे च यथा नृपाः ॥
ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मकल्पाश्च तथैव सुसमागताः ॥ 1.1.10 ॥
1.1.m: Out of affection they spoke to Vajra, the giver of thousands of gifts: / "O king, as in the Tretā age, and as in the Dvāpara age kings, / and brahmins who were equal to Brahmā, assembled in like manner,

1.1.s:
asmiṃstiṣye ca saṃprāpte tava rājanprasādataḥ ..
rājan kṛṣṇasagotro'si teneyante sabhā nṛpa .. 11 ..
1.1.d:
अस्मिंस्तिष्ये च संप्राप्ते तव राजन्प्रसादतः ॥
राजन् कृष्णसगोत्रोऽसि तेनेयन्ते सभा नृप ॥ 11 ॥
1.1.m: now that this Kali age has arrived, through your favor, O king — / O king, you are of Kṛṣṇa’s lineage, and therefore this assembly of yours, O ruler of men,

1.1.s:
upāsyate mahābhāgairbrahmakalpaistapodhanaiḥ ..
....... . . .. na tathā vīryanirjitā .. 12..
1.1.d:
उपास्यते महाभागैर्ब्रह्मकल्पैस्तपोधनैः ॥
॥॥॥॥ ॥। न तथा वीर्यनिर्जिता ॥ 12॥
1.1.m: is attended upon by illustrious [sages] whose wealth is asceticism, equal to Brahmā. / […] not so conquered by prowess,

1.1.s:
bhaktyā yathā tu tasyaiva kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
tena kṛṣṇena ye cakrurvyatītāḥ pūrvapārthivāḥ .. 13 ..
1.1.d:
भक्त्या यथा तु तस्यैव कृष्णस्यामिततेजसः ॥
तेन कृष्णेन ये चक्रुर्व्यतीताः पूर्वपार्थिवाः ॥ 13 ॥
1.1.m: as through devotion to that very Kṛṣṇa of boundless splendor. / The past rulers of the earth who acted with that Kṛṣṇa,

1.1.s:
varttatā tena kṛṣṇena te rājanmokṣamāpnuyuḥ..
atha tiṣyayugaḥ prāpto ghoraḥ paramadāruṇaḥ .. 14..
1.1.d:
वर्त्तता तेन कृष्णेन ते राजन्मोक्षमाप्नुयुः॥
अथ तिष्ययुगः प्राप्तो घोरः परमदारुणः ॥ 14॥
1.1.m: with that Kṛṣṇa living [among them], O king, could attain liberation. / But now the Kali age has arrived, fierce and exceedingly terrible,

1.1.s: durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ yatra nṛpasaṃghe mahātmanām .. 15 ..
1.1.d: दुर्लभं दर्शनं यत्र नृपसंघे महात्मनाम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.1.m: in which the sight of great-souled [sages] is rare to obtain in an assembly of kings.

1.1.s:
tasmāttvaṃ rājaśārdūla praṣṭumarho dvijottamān ..
vaiṣṇavānvividhāndharmānsarahasyānsasaṃgrahān.. 16..
1.1.d:
तस्मात्त्वं राजशार्दूल प्रष्टुमर्हो द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
वैष्णवान्विविधान्धर्मान्सरहस्यान्ससंग्रहान्॥ 16॥
1.1.m: Therefore, O tiger among kings, you ought to ask the foremost of the twice-born / about the various Vaiṣṇava dharmas, along with their secret teachings and summaries."

1.1.s:
ityevamukto vajrastaistyaktvā siṃhāsanaṃ tadā ..
vajraṃ tu prāñjaliṃ dṛṣṭvā sarva eva narādhipāḥ .. 17 ..
1.1.d:
इत्येवमुक्तो वज्रस्तैस्त्यक्त्वा सिंहासनं तदा ॥
वज्रं तु प्राञ्जलिं दृष्ट्वा सर्व एव नराधिपाः ॥ 17 ॥
1.1.m: Addressed thus by them, Vajra then stepped down from his throne; / and seeing Vajra with folded hands, all the rulers of men,

1.1.s:
varāsanānvihāyāśu tasthuḥ prāñjalayastadā ..
vajra uvāca .. bhavadbhirnṛpaśārdūlāḥ prārthitā ye dvijāḥ śritāḥ .. 18 ..
1.1.d:
वरासनान्विहायाशु तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा ॥
वज्र उवाच ॥ भवद्भिर्नृपशार्दूलाः प्रार्थिता ये द्विजाः श्रिताः ॥ 18 ॥
1.1.m: quickly leaving their noble seats, stood with folded hands. / Vajra said: "O tigers among kings, the twice-born whom you have approached with entreaties,

1.1.s:
anugrahārthaṃ bhūpānāṃ jagato hitakāmyayā ..
bhavanto vaktumarhanti viṣṇudharmānsanātanān .. 19 ..
1.1.d:
अनुग्रहार्थं भूपानां जगतो हितकाम्यया ॥
भवन्तो वक्तुमर्हन्ति विष्णुधर्मान्सनातनान् ॥ 19 ॥
1.1.m: for the favor of rulers of the earth, wishing the welfare of the world, / ought to speak of the eternal dharmas of Viṣṇu.

1.1.s:
tasmāttiṣyayuge nāsti bhavato darśanaṃ nṛpaiḥ ..
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
uttiṣṭha tvaṃ mahīpāla alaṅkuru svamāsanam .. 1.1.20 ..
1.1.d:
तस्मात्तिष्ययुगे नास्ति भवतो दर्शनं नृपैः ॥
ऋषय ऊचुः ॥
उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महीपाल अलङ्कुरु स्वमासनम् ॥ 1.1.20 ॥
1.1.m: Therefore in the Kali age their sight is not [ordinarily] obtained by kings." / The sages said: / "Arise, O ruler of the earth, and adorn your throne.

1.1.s:
śravaṇepi vayaṃ tasya viśeṣeṇārthitā nṛpa ..
vajra te saṃśayānsarvāñchetsyatyeṣa mahāmuniḥ .. 21 ..
1.1.d:
श्रवणेपि वयं तस्य विशेषेणार्थिता नृप ॥
वज्र ते संशयान्सर्वाञ्छेत्स्यत्येष महामुनिः ॥ 21 ॥
1.1.m: We too are particularly eager to hear it, O king. / Vajra, this great sage will sever all your doubts."

1.1.s:
ityevamuktvā vajraṃ te ṛṣayastapasi sthitāḥ ..
mārkaṇḍeyamathocuste brūhi dharmānmahīpate..22..
1.1.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वज्रं ते ऋषयस्तपसि स्थिताः ॥
मार्कण्डेयमथोचुस्ते ब्रूहि धर्मान्महीपते॥22॥
1.1.m: Having spoken thus to Vajra, those sages engaged in asceticism / then said to Mārkaṇḍeya: "Declare the dharmas, O [sage of the] ruler of the earth,

1.1.s:
vaiṣṇavānvividhāndharmāṃllokānāmaghahāriṇaḥ..
tathā pārthivasaṃghasya saṃśayān manasi sthitān..23..
1.1.d:
वैष्णवान्विविधान्धर्मांल्लोकानामघहारिणः॥
तथा पार्थिवसंघस्य संशयान् मनसि स्थितान्॥23॥
1.1.m: the various Vaiṣṇava dharmas that take away the sins of the worlds, / and the doubts residing in the mind of the assembly of kings."

1.1.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
brahmaṇyaḥ satyavān dhanyaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ..
yadyatpṛcchasi māṃ vajra tattadvaktāsmyasaṃśayam..24..
1.1.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवान् धन्यः सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः॥
यद्यत्पृच्छसि मां वज्र तत्तद्वक्तास्म्यसंशयम्॥24॥
1.1.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Pious, truthful, blessed one, destroyer of all enemies, / whatever you ask me, Vajra, I shall surely explain.

1.1.s:
sihāsanastho bhava bhūmipāla kvaitrakārutva bhavantu sarve'pi tathā mahīpāḥ ..
sukhopaviṣṭairiha bhūmipālaiḥ svasaṃśayān brūhi yathāprakāmam .. 25 ..
1.1.d:
सिहासनस्थो भव भूमिपाल क्वैत्रकारुत्व भवन्तु सर्वेऽपि तथा महीपाः ॥
सुखोपविष्टैरिह भूमिपालैः स्वसंशयान् ब्रूहि यथाप्रकामम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.1.m: Be seated on your throne, O ruler of the earth! Let all the kings likewise be comfortable; / with the rulers of the earth comfortably seated here, declare your doubts according to your desire."

1.1.s:
ityevamuktaḥ sa yadupradhāno bhṛguprabarheṇa maharṣimadhye ..
praṇamya viprānsa jagāma rājā siṃhāsanaṃ ratnasahasracitram .. 26 ..
1.1.d:
इत्येवमुक्तः स यदुप्रधानो भृगुप्रबर्हेण महर्षिमध्ये ॥
प्रणम्य विप्रान्स जगाम राजा सिंहासनं रत्नसहस्रचित्रम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.1.m: Addressed thus by the eminent Bhṛgu among the great sages, / having bowed to the brahmins, that chief of the Yadus went to his throne, variegated with thousands of jewels.

1.1.s:
siṃhāsanasthe nṛpavaryamukhye siṃhāsanasthāḥ kṣitipapradhānāḥ ..
sarve babhūvuḥ praṇatāstathā ca śuśrūṣavo brāhmaṇamukhyavākyam .. 27 ..
1.1.d:
सिंहासनस्थे नृपवर्यमुख्ये सिंहासनस्थाः क्षितिपप्रधानाः ॥
सर्वे बभूवुः प्रणतास्तथा च शुश्रूषवो ब्राह्मणमुख्यवाक्यम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.1.m: When the foremost of excellent kings was seated on his throne, the principal rulers of the earth / all sat on their thrones, bowing and eager to hear the words of the chief of brahmins.

1.1.s:
vajra uvāca ..
ācakṣva mahyaṃ bhṛguvaṃśacandra samudbhavaṃ tvaṃ jagato yathāvat .. .
śṛṇvaṃti me brāhmaṇasaṃghamukhyā nareṃdramukhyāśca vacastvadīyam .. 28 ..
1.1.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
आचक्ष्व मह्यं भृगुवंशचन्द्र समुद्भवं त्वं जगतो यथावत् ॥ ।
शृण्वंति मे ब्राह्मणसंघमुख्या नरेंद्रमुख्याश्च वचस्त्वदीयम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.1.m: Vajra said: / "Tell me accurately, O moon of the Bhṛgu lineage, the origin of the world. / The chiefs of the assemblies of brahmins and the foremost of rulers of men are listening to your word."

1.2.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya sarvabhūtaparāyaṇam ..
lakṣmīsahāyaṃ varadaṃ śeṣaparyaṅkaśāyinam .. 1 ..
1.2.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य सर्वभूतपरायणम् ॥
लक्ष्मीसहायं वरदं शेषपर्यङ्कशायिनम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.2.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having bowed to Nārāyaṇa, the refuge of all beings, / the companion of Lakṣmī, the giver of boons, who reclines on the couch of Śeṣa,

1.2.s:
jagato'sya samutpattisthitināśaikakāraṇam ..
jñānajñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya saṃsthitam .. 2 ..
1.2.d:
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिनाशैककारणम् ॥
ज्ञानज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य संस्थितम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.2.m: the sole cause of the arising, maintenance, and destruction of this world, / known through knowledge, reachable through knowledge, seated in the heart of all,

1.2.s:
vakṣyāmi jagatāṃ rājansamutpattiṃ nibodha tām ..
sarvapāpapraśamanīmāyuṣyāṃ svargadāṃ śivām .. 3 ..
1.2.d:
वक्ष्यामि जगतां राजन्समुत्पत्तिं निबोध ताम् ॥
सर्वपापप्रशमनीमायुष्यां स्वर्गदां शिवाम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.2.m: I shall declare the origin of the worlds, O king; listen to it: / it pacifies all evil, bestows long life, grants heaven, and is auspicious.

1.2.s:
nārāyaṇo'sya jagataḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārapālanam ..
karoti jagatīpāla yasya sarvamidaṃ mahān .. 4 ..
1.2.d:
नारायणोऽस्य जगतः सृष्टिसंहारपालनम् ॥
करोति जगतीपाल यस्य सर्वमिदं महान् ॥ 4 ॥
1.2.m: Nārāyaṇa performs the creation, dissolution, and preservation of this world, / O ruler of the earth, he whose great [form] this all is.

1.2.s:
vedeṣu gīyate yo'sau puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ..
anādinidhano dhātā tvanantaḥ puruṣottamaḥ .. 5 ..
1.2.d:
वेदेषु गीयते योऽसौ पुरुषः पञ्चविंशकः ॥
अनादिनिधनो धाता त्वनन्तः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ 5 ॥
1.2.m: He who is sung in the Vedas as the twenty-fifth principle, the Cosmic Person, / without beginning or end, the creator, infinite, the Puruṣottama;

1.2.s:
yasyonmeṣastu divaso brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
nimeṣastu tathā rātristacca kalpaṃ prakīrtitam .. 6 ..
1.2.d:
यस्योन्मेषस्तु दिवसो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः ॥
निमेषस्तु तथा रात्रिस्तच्च कल्पं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.2.m: whose opening of the eyes is a day of Brahmā Parameṣṭhin, / and whose closing of the eyes is likewise a night, and that is called an aeon.

1.2.s:
puruṣatve tvanantasya na rūpaṃ nṛpa vidyate ..
na ca śabdo na ca ghrāṇaḥ sparśo vā pṛthivīpate .. 7 ..
1.2.d:
पुरुषत्वे त्वनन्तस्य न रूपं नृप विद्यते ॥
न च शब्दो न च घ्राणः स्पर्शो वा पृथिवीपते ॥ 7 ॥
1.2.m: In the personhood of the infinite one, O king, no form exists, / nor sound, nor smell, nor touch, O ruler of the earth.

1.2.s:
na tasya parimāṇaṃ vā na cādirnidhanaṃ kutaḥ ..
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ .. 8 ..
1.2.d:
न तस्य परिमाणं वा न चादिर्निधनं कुतः ॥
सर्वतः पाणिपादान्तः सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखः ॥ 8 ॥
1.2.m: He has no measure, nor a beginning; whence could he have an end? / With hands and feet extending everywhere, with eyes, heads, and faces on all sides,

1.2.s:
sarvataḥ śrutimām̐lloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ..
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam .. 9 ..
1.2.d:
सर्वतः श्रुतिमाम्̐ल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.2.m: possessing ears everywhere in the world, he stands encompassing all; / appearing as the qualities of all senses, yet devoid of all senses,

1.2.s:
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca ..
taṃ ca prāpya bhavantīha ye muktāḥ puruṣottamāḥ .. 1.2.10 ..
1.2.d:
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥
तं च प्राप्य भवन्तीह ये मुक्ताः पुरुषोत्तमाः ॥ 1.2.10 ॥
1.2.m: unattached, yet sustaining everything, devoid of qualities, yet experiencing qualities; / and having attained him here, those who are liberated become highest of men.

1.2.s:
sugatiryogasiddhānāṃ tasmātsarvasya sambhavaḥ ..
tasmādbhavati cāvyaktastasmādātmāpi jāyate .. 11 ..
1.2.d:
सुगतिर्योगसिद्धानां तस्मात्सर्वस्य सम्भवः ॥
तस्माद्भवति चाव्यक्तस्तस्मादात्मापि जायते ॥ 11 ॥
1.2.m: He is the good destination of those perfected in yoga; from him is the origin of all. / From him comes the unmanifest, and from him the Self also is born.

1.2.s:
tasmādbuddhirmanastasmāttataḥ khaṃ pavanastataḥ ..
tasmāttejastatastvāpastebhyoṇḍamabhavatkila .. 12 ..
1.2.d:
तस्माद्बुद्धिर्मनस्तस्मात्ततः खं पवनस्ततः ॥
तस्मात्तेजस्ततस्त्वापस्तेभ्योण्डमभवत्किल ॥ 12 ॥
1.2.m: From him intellect, from that the mind, then space, from that wind; / from that fire, and then water; and from these arose the egg.

1.2.s:
aṇḍo hiraṇmayo rājaṃstasyāntaḥ svayameva hi ..
śarīragrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ kurute prabhuḥ .. 13 ..
1.2.d:
अण्डो हिरण्मयो राजंस्तस्यान्तः स्वयमेव हि ॥
शरीरग्रहणं पूर्वं सृष्ट्यर्थं कुरुते प्रभुः ॥ 13 ॥
1.2.m: It was a golden egg, O king, and inside it the Lord himself / assumed a body in the beginning for the purpose of creation.

1.2.s:
brahmā caturmukho devo rajomātrādhikaḥ sadā ..
śarīragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā sṛjatīdaṃ carācaram.. 14 ..
1.2.d:
ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखो देवो रजोमात्राधिकः सदा ॥
शरीरग्रहणं कृत्वा सृजतीदं चराचरम्॥ 14 ॥
1.2.m: The god Brahmā, four-faced, having a predominance of the quality of passion, / having assumed a body, always creates this [universe] of moving and unmoving beings.

1.2.s:
aṇḍasyāntarjagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ..
saptalokān sapātālānsaptadvīpārṇavāṃ mahīm .. 15 ..
1.2.d:
अण्डस्यान्तर्जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ॥
सप्तलोकान् सपातालान्सप्तद्वीपार्णवां महीम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.2.m: Inside the egg is the entire world, together with gods, asuras, and humans, / the seven worlds, the netherworlds, and the earth with its seven continents and oceans.

1.2.s:
sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā sa bhagavān sāttvikīmāsthitastanum ..
kṣīrode keśavo bhūtvā śeṣabhogamayaḥ prabhuḥ .. 16 ..
1.2.d:
सृष्टिं कृत्वा स भगवान् सात्त्विकीमास्थितस्तनुम् ॥
क्षीरोदे केशवो भूत्वा शेषभोगमयः प्रभुः ॥ 16 ॥
1.2.m: Having brought forth creation, that blessed lord, assuming a body of goodness, / becomes Keśava in the Milk Ocean, made of the coils of Śeṣa.

1.2.s:
lakṣmīsahāyo lokāṃstu sarvānpālayate sadā ..
yoganidrāṃ samāsthāya sarvasattvaśarīragaḥ .. 17 ..
1.2.d:
लक्ष्मीसहायो लोकांस्तु सर्वान्पालयते सदा ॥
योगनिद्रां समास्थाय सर्वसत्त्वशरीरगः ॥ 17 ॥
1.2.m: Accompanied by Lakṣmī, he continually protects all the worlds; / having entered the sleep of yoga, he dwells within the bodies of all beings.

1.2.s:
śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi sarveṣāṃ sa hi paśyati ..
antakāle haro bhūtvā jagatsaṃharate punaḥ ..18..
1.2.d:
शुभाशुभानि कर्माणि सर्वेषां स हि पश्यति ॥
अन्तकाले हरो भूत्वा जगत्संहरते पुनः ॥18॥
1.2.m: Indeed, he witnesses the good and bad deeds of everyone; / and at the time of the end, having become Hara, he dissolves the world once again.

1.2.s:
tāmasīṃ tanumāsthāya līlayaiva mahāyaśāḥ ..
brahmāto sṛṣṭikāle tu jalamadhyagatāṃ mahīm .. 19 ..
1.2.d:
तामसीं तनुमास्थाय लीलयैव महायशाः ॥
ब्रह्मातो सृष्टिकाले तु जलमध्यगतां महीम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.2.m: Assuming a body of darkness, with ease he, of great renown, / becomes Brahmā at the time of creation. But seeing the earth gone into the midst of the waters,

1.2.s:
dṛṣṭvoddharati yajñātmā vārāhīmāsthitastanum ..
brahmāsya sarge paripālane ca viṣṇurmahātmā bhavatīha nityam..
saṃhārakāle ca haratvameti traidhaṃ vidhatte sa trikālayogāt .. 1.2.20 ..
1.2.d:
दृष्ट्वोद्धरति यज्ञात्मा वाराहीमास्थितस्तनुम् ॥
ब्रह्मास्य सर्गे परिपालने च विष्णुर्महात्मा भवतीह नित्यम्॥
संहारकाले च हरत्वमेति त्रैधं विधत्ते स त्रिकालयोगात् ॥ 1.2.20 ॥
1.2.m: the embodiment of sacrifice raises it up, having assumed a boar's body. / In creation he is Brahmā, and in preservation he is constantly the great-souled Viṣṇu here; / and at the time of dissolution he attains the nature of Hara: thus he manifests threefold through the connection with the three times.

1.3.s:
..mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
brahmarātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ vibuddhe padmasambhave ..
viṣṇuḥ sisṛkṣurbhūtānāṃ jñātvā bhūmiṃ jalāntagām .. 1 ..
1.3.d:
॥मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ब्रह्मरात्र्यां व्यतीतायां विबुद्धे पद्मसम्भवे ॥
विष्णुः सिसृक्षुर्भूतानां ज्ञात्वा भूमिं जलान्तगाम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the night of Brahmā had passed and the lotus-born [Brahmā] had awakened, / Viṣṇu, desiring to create living beings, knew that the earth had gone into the waters.

1.3.s:
jalakrīḍāruci śubhaṃ kalpādiṣu yathā purā ..
vārāhamāsthito rūpamujjahāra vasundharām.. 2 ..
vedapādyūpadaṃṣṭraśca caturvaktraścaturmukhaḥ ..
1.3.d:
जलक्रीडारुचि शुभं कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा ॥
वाराहमास्थितो रूपमुज्जहार वसुन्धराम्॥ 2 ॥
वेदपाद्यूपदंष्ट्रश्च चतुर्वक्त्रश्चतुर्मुखः ॥
1.3.m:
Delighting in water-sports, in the auspicious beginnings of aeons as of old, / having assumed the form of a boar, he raised up the earth.
The Vedas are his feet, the sacrificial post his tusk, he is four-voiced and four-faced,
fire is his tongue, darbha grass his hair, Brahmā his head, great in austerity,

1.3.s:
ahorātrekṣaṇo divyo vedāṅgaḥ śrutibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān .. .. 4..
1.3.d:
अहोरात्रेक्षणो दिव्यो वेदाङ्गः श्रुतिभूषणः ॥
आज्यनासः स्रुवतुण्डः सामघोषस्वनो महान् ॥ ॥ 4॥
1.3.m: day and night are his eyes, divine, the limbs of the Veda his body, adorned by the scriptures, / ghee is his snout, the sacrificial ladle his mouth, with a great voice resembling the chant of the Sāman hymns,

1.3.s:
dharmaḥ satyamahāḥ śrīmānkarmavikramasatkṛtaḥ ..
prāyaścittamayo dhīraḥ prāṃśujānurmahāyaśāḥ ..
udgātraṃtro homaliṅgaḥ phalabījamahauṣadhiḥ .. 5 ..
1.3.d:
धर्मः सत्यमहाः श्रीमान्कर्मविक्रमसत्कृतः ॥
प्रायश्चित्तमयो धीरः प्रांशुजानुर्महायशाः ॥
उद्गात्रंत्रो होमलिङ्गः फलबीजमहौषधिः ॥ 5 ॥
1.3.m: dharma and truth are his great majesty, glorious, honoured by deeds of stride, / composed of expiations, firm, with lofty knees, of great renown, / having the udgātṛ's chant for his entrails, sacrificial offerings for his gender, with fruits, seeds, and great herbs,

1.3.s:
vāyvantarātmā mantrāsthirvikṛtaḥ somaśoṇitaḥ ..
vedaskaṃdho havirgandho havyakavyātivegavān .. 6 ..
1.3.d:
वाय्वन्तरात्मा मन्त्रास्थिर्विकृतः सोमशोणितः ॥
वेदस्कंधो हविर्गन्धो हव्यकव्यातिवेगवान् ॥ 6 ॥
1.3.m: the wind for his inner self, sacred formulas his bones, transformed, with Soma for his blood, / the Vedas his shoulders, the scent of oblations his fragrance, moving with extreme speed through offerings to gods and ancestors,

1.3.s:
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimānnānādīkṣābhiranvitaḥ ..
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahākratumayo mahān.. 7 ..
1.3.d:
प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमान्नानादीक्षाभिरन्वितः ॥
दक्षिणाहृदयो योगी महाक्रतुमयो महान्॥ 7 ॥
1.3.m: having the prāgvaṃśa hall for his body, radiant, endowed with diverse consecrations, / the sacrificial fee his heart, a yogin, composed of great sacrifices, vast,

1.3.s:
upākarmeṣṭiruciraḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ..
māyāpatnīsahāyo vai mahāśṛṃṅga ivoditām ..6..
1.3.d:
उपाकर्मेष्टिरुचिरः प्रवर्ग्यावर्तभूषणः॥
मायापत्नीसहायो वै महाशृंङ्ग इवोदिताम् ॥6॥
1.3.m: shining with introductory rites and offerings, adorned with the whirlpool-curl of the pravargya, / accompanied by the illusory consort, resembling a great mountain peak that has arisen,

1.3.s:
mahīṃ sāgara paryantāṃ saśailavanakānanām ..
ekārṇavajalabhraṣṭāmekārṇavagataḥ prabhuḥ .. 9 ..
1.3.d:
महीं सागर पर्यन्तां सशैलवनकाननाम् ॥
एकार्णवजलभ्रष्टामेकार्णवगतः प्रभुः ॥ 9 ॥
1.3.m: the earth bordered by oceans, with its mountains, forests, and groves, / fallen into the waters of the single ocean, the lord, having entered that single ocean,

1.3.s:
daṃṣṭrāgreṇa samuddhṛtya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
ādidevo mahāyogī cakāra jagatīṃ punaḥ .. 1.3.10 ..
1.3.d:
दंष्ट्राग्रेण समुद्धृत्य लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
आदिदेवो महायोगी चकार जगतीं पुनः ॥ 1.3.10 ॥
1.3.m: lifted it up with the tip of his tusk out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds; / the primeval god, the great yogin, established the world anew.

1.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā varāheṇa bhūtvā bhūtahitārthinā ..
uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī jalamadhyagatā purā .. 11 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा वराहेण भूत्वा भूतहितार्थिना ॥
उद्धृता पृथिवी देवी जलमध्यगता पुरा ॥ 11 ॥
1.3.m: Knowing thus, having become a boar seeking the welfare of living beings, / the goddess Earth, sunken in the midst of the waters, was raised up of old.

1.3.s:
uddhṛtya bhūmiṃ sa vibhurmahātmā varāharūpeṇa jalāntarasthām ..
cakre vibhāgaṃ jagatastadīśo yathāyathā tacchṛṇu rājasiṃha .. 12 ..
1.3.d:
उद्धृत्य भूमिं स विभुर्महात्मा वराहरूपेण जलान्तरस्थाम् ॥
चक्रे विभागं जगतस्तदीशो यथायथा तच्छृणु राजसिंह ॥ 12 ॥
1.3.m: Having raised up the earth standing inside the waters by his boar-form, that all-pervading, great-souled lord / made the division of the world; hear that duly, O lion among kings.

1.4.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
jālāntaragate bhānau yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ ..
prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate .. 1 ..
1.4.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
जालान्तरगते भानौ यत्सूक्ष्मं दृश्यते रजः ॥
प्रथमं तत्प्रमाणानां त्रसरेणुं प्रचक्षते ॥ 1 ॥
1.4.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The subtle dust that is seen when the sun has entered through a lattice window / is declared to be the first of measurements, a speck of dust.

1.4.s:
trasareṇavo'ṣṭau vijñeyā likṣaikā parimāṇataḥ ..
tā rājasarṣapāstisrastāstrayo gaurasarṣapāḥ .. 2 ..
1.4.d:
त्रसरेणवोऽष्टौ विज्ञेया लिक्षैका परिमाणतः ॥
ता राजसर्षपास्तिस्रस्तास्त्रयो गौरसर्षपाः ॥ 2 ॥
1.4.m: Eight specks of dust are to be known as one nit in measure; / three of those are a black mustard seed, and three of those are a white mustard seed.

1.4.s:
sarṣapāḥ ṣaḍyavo madhye aṅgulaṃ ca tadaṣṭakam ..
dvādaśāṅgulikaḥ śaṅkustaddvayaṃ hasta ucyate ..3..
1.4.d:
सर्षपाः षड्यवो मध्ये अङ्गुलं च तदष्टकम् ॥
द्वादशाङ्गुलिकः शङ्कुस्तद्द्वयं हस्त उच्यते ॥3॥
1.4.m: Six mustard seeds are a barley corn in the middle, and eight of those are a finger-breadth; / twelve finger-breadths make a span, and two of those are called a cubit.

1.4.s:
taccatuṣkaṃ dhanuḥ proktaṃ krośo dhanuḥsahasrikā ..
krośadvayaṃ ca gavyūtiḥ yojanaṃ taccatuṣṭayam .. 4 ..
1.4.d:
तच्चतुष्कं धनुः प्रोक्तं क्रोशो धनुःसहस्रिका ॥
क्रोशद्वयं च गव्यूतिः योजनं तच्चतुष्टयम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.4.m: Four of those are declared to be a bow; a krośa is a thousand bows; / two krośas are a gavyūti, and four of those are a yojana.

1.4.s:
yojanānāṃ pramāṇena cāyutānāṃ śatatrayam ..
ayutānāṃ ca pañcāśaccheṣasthānaṃ manoharam .. 5 ..
1.4.d:
योजनानां प्रमाणेन चायुतानां शतत्रयम् ॥
अयुतानां च पञ्चाशच्छेषस्थानं मनोहरम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.4.m: In measure of yojanas, three hundred tens of thousands / and fifty tens of thousands is the delightful abode of Śeṣa.

1.4.s:
sa eva loke vārāhaḥ kathitaśca svayaṃ prabhuḥ ..
vārāharūpī bhagavāñchatarūpadharastathā ..6..
1.4.d:
स एव लोके वाराहः कथितश्च स्वयं प्रभुः ॥
वाराहरूपी भगवाञ्छतरूपधरस्तथा ॥6॥
1.4.m: He alone is declared to be the Boar in the world, the self-existent lord, / the blessed one possessing the form of the Boar, and also bearing a hundred forms.

1.4.s:
tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurbhaktaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ ..
loko'yamaṃḍasaṃlagnaśchatrākāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 7 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रास्ते भगवान्विष्णुर्भक्तैः सह महात्मभिः ॥
लोकोऽयमंडसंलग्नश्छत्राकारः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 7 ॥
1.4.m: There dwells the blessed Viṣṇu along with great-souled devotees; / this world, attached to the [cosmic] egg, is proclaimed to be umbrella-shaped.

1.4.s:
svayaṃ prabhurvītarajāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ ..
ekāntabhāvopagatāstaṃ prayānti hari janāḥ .. 8 ..
1.4.d:
स्वयं प्रभुर्वीतरजाः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः ॥
एकान्तभावोपगतास्तं प्रयान्ति हरि जनाः ॥ 8 ॥
1.4.m: The self-existent lord is free from passion and rid of all sorrow; / people devoted to single-minded devotion go to that Hari.

1.4.s:
sarvādhastādayaṃ lokaḥ kathitaste manoharaḥ ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ .. 9 ..
1.4.d:
सर्वाधस्तादयं लोकः कथितस्ते मनोहरः ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥ 9 ॥
1.4.m: This delightful world, beneath everything, has been described to you; / above it is another, of just the same measure.

1.4.s:
kālāgnirudralokastu kathyate'gnisamarcitaḥ ..
eka eva sa tatrāste svaprabhābhāsvarātmakaḥ .. 1.4.10..
1.4.d:
कालाग्निरुद्रलोकस्तु कथ्यतेऽग्निसमर्चितः ॥
एक एव स तत्रास्ते स्वप्रभाभास्वरात्मकः ॥ 1.4.10॥
1.4.m: The world of Kālāgnirudra, worshipped by fire, is spoken of; / he alone abides there, radiant with his own light.

1.4.s:
tasmātsamutthito vahnirjagatprāpte dinakṣaye ..
bhasmasātkurute sarvaṃ yacceṅgaṃ yacca neṅgate .. 11..
1.4.d:
तस्मात्समुत्थितो वह्निर्जगत्प्राप्ते दिनक्षये ॥
भस्मसात्कुरुते सर्वं यच्चेङ्गं यच्च नेङ्गते ॥ 11॥
1.4.m: The fire arisen from him, when the end of the day arrives for the world, / reduces to ashes everything that moves and that does not move.

1.4.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ...
pātālanāmā pātālaḥ prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 12 ..
1.4.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥।
पातालनामा पातालः प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 12 ॥
1.4.m: Above it is another of just the same measure; / the first netherworld, named Pātāla, is proclaimed.

1.4.s:
yogamāyāṃ samāsthāya dvitīyāmāsthitastanum ..
sarvato bhagavānāste śeṣamūrtirjanārdanaḥ .. ..13..
1.4.d:
योगमायां समास्थाय द्वितीयामास्थितस्तनुम् ॥
सर्वतो भगवानास्ते शेषमूर्तिर्जनार्दनः ॥ ॥13॥
1.4.m: Resorting to yoga-illusion, having assumed a second body, / the blessed lord Janārdana dwells everywhere in the form of Śeṣa.

1.4.s:
rukmabhaumaḥ sa pātālo dhṛto rudrasya tejasā ..
tasminsa bhagavānāste śeṣaparyaṅkamāsthitaḥ .. 14 ..
1.4.d:
रुक्मभौमः स पातालो धृतो रुद्रस्य तेजसा ॥
तस्मिन्स भगवानास्ते शेषपर्यङ्कमास्थितः ॥ 14 ॥
1.4.m: That netherworld has golden soil and is held by the splendour of Rudra; / in it dwells the blessed lord, seated on the couch of Śeṣa,

1.4.s:
nityaṃ tāladhvajo vāgmī vanamālāvibhū ṣitaḥ ..
dhārayañchirasā nityaṃ ratnacitrāṃ phaṇāvalīm .. 15..
1.4.d:
नित्यं तालध्वजो वाग्मी वनमालाविभू षितः ॥
धारयञ्छिरसा नित्यं रत्नचित्रां फणावलीम् ॥ 15॥
1.4.m: constantly having a palm-tree banner, eloquent, adorned with a woodland garland, / constantly bearing upon his head a row of hoods variegated with jewels,

1.4.s:
lāṅgalī musalī khaḍgī nīlāmbaravibhūṣitaḥ ..
stūyamānaḥ sa gandharvairnāgairṛṣivaraistathā. ..16..
1.4.d:
लाङ्गली मुसली खड्गी नीलाम्बरविभूषितः ॥
स्तूयमानः स गन्धर्वैर्नागैरृषिवरैस्तथा॥.16॥
1.4.m: holding a plough, a pestle, and a sword, adorned with dark blue garments, / being praised by gandharvas, nāgas, and foremost sages.

1.4.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
sutalasaṃjñaḥ pātāla śilābhāsaḥ samantataḥ ..17..
1.4.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
सुतलसंज्ञः पाताल शिलाभासः समन्ततः ॥17॥
1.4.m: Above it is another of just the same measure, / the netherworld named Sutala, with the appearance of stone all around.

1.4.s:
balistu bhagavāṃstatra bahistiṣṭhatisaṃyataḥ ..
ramyaṃ puravaraṃ tasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ svayam .. 18 ..
1.4.d:
बलिस्तु भगवांस्तत्र बहिस्तिष्ठतिसंयतः ॥
रम्यं पुरवरं तस्य विष्णुना निर्मितं स्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.4.m: The blessed Bali stays there, restrained on the outside; / a lovely, excellent city was built for him by Viṣṇu himself,

1.4.s:
nivāsaṃ devarājasya viśiṣṭaṃ tatpurottamam ..
sā vaiṣṇavī kalā proktā yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat .. 19 ..
1.4.d:
निवासं देवराजस्य विशिष्टं तत्पुरोत्तमम् ॥
सा वैष्णवी कला प्रोक्ता ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.4.m: an abode distinguished even from that of the king of gods, an excellent city. / That is declared to be the part of Viṣṇu by which this world is sustained,

1.4.s:
(phaṇeṣu tasya viśrāntā militā ca śubhāśubhā ..
tatrāste sa mahābhāgaḥ śriyā paramayā yutaḥ..1.4.20..
1.4.d:
(फणेषु तस्य विश्रान्ता मिलिता च शुभाशुभा ॥
तत्रास्ते स महाभागः श्रिया परमया युतः॥1.4.20॥
1.4.m: resting upon his hoods, combined of the auspicious and inauspicious. / There dwells that highly fortunate one, endowed with supreme glory.

1.4.s:
tamupāsanti satataṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..)
tatrāste devadevasya mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇasya cāparā .. 21 ..
1.4.d:
तमुपासन्ति सततं गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः ॥)
तत्रास्ते देवदेवस्य मूर्तिः कृष्णस्य चापरा ॥ 21 ॥
1.4.m: Crowds of gandharvas and apsarases constantly attend upon him. / There abides another form of Kṛṣṇa, god of gods.

1.4.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
ābhāsatala ityeva pātālo nīlamṛttikaḥ .. 22 ..
1.4.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
आभासतल इत्येव पातालो नीलमृत्तिकः ॥ 22 ॥
1.4.m: Above it is another of just the same measure, / the netherworld called Ābhāsatala, with dark blue earth.

1.4.s:
tṛtīyaḥ sa tu vikhyātaḥ surabhiryatra tiṣṭhati ..
digdhenavastathā tatra catasraśca tathā sthitāḥ .. 23 ..
1.4.d:
तृतीयः स तु विख्यातः सुरभिर्यत्र तिष्ठति ॥
दिग्धेनवस्तथा तत्र चतस्रश्च तथा स्थिताः ॥ 23 ॥
1.4.m: That is known as the third, where Surabhi dwells; / and four direction-cows also stay there:

1.4.s:
subhadrā vahnirūpā ca viśvarūpā tathaiva ca ..
rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā yābhirvṛtamidaṃ jagat .. 24 ..
1.4.d:
सुभद्रा वह्निरूपा च विश्वरूपा तथैव च ॥
रोहिणी च महाभागा याभिर्वृतमिदं जगत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.4.m: Subhadrā, Vahnirūpā, Viśvarūpā, / and the highly fortunate Rohiṇī, by whom this world is encompassed.

1.4.s:
tāsāṃ kṣīreṇa sarvāsāṃ kṛtaḥ kṣīrārṇavaḥ prabho ..
pātālamadhye tasmiṃstu puraṃ viṣṇormanoramam.. .. 25 ..
1.4.d:
तासां क्षीरेण सर्वासां कृतः क्षीरार्णवः प्रभो ॥
पातालमध्ये तस्मिंस्तु पुरं विष्णोर्मनोरमम्॥ ॥ 25 ॥
1.4.m: From the milk of them all the Ocean of Milk was made, O Lord; / and in the midst of that netherworld is the delightful city of Viṣṇu,

1.4.s:
yatrāste bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śeṣaparyaṅkagastathā ..
agnijvālāparikṣiptaḥ saha lakṣmyā parantapa .. 26 ..
1.4.d:
यत्रास्ते भगवान्विष्णुः शेषपर्यङ्कगस्तथा ॥
अग्निज्वालापरिक्षिप्तः सह लक्ष्म्या परन्तप ॥ 26 ॥
1.4.m: where the blessed Lord Viṣṇu rests on the couch of Śeṣa, / encircled by flames of fire, together with Lakṣmī, O scorcher of foes.

1.4.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
pītabhaumaścaturthastu gabhastitalasaṃjñitaḥ .. 27 ..
1.4.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
पीतभौमश्चतुर्थस्तु गभस्तितलसंज्ञितः ॥ 27 ॥
1.4.m: Above that is another of the very same extent: / the fourth, yellow-earthed, named Gabhastitala.

1.4.s:
tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurdevo hayaśirodharaḥ ..
śaśāṃkaśatasaṃkāśaḥ śātakauṃbhavibhūṣaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रास्ते भगवान्विष्णुर्देवो हयशिरोधरः ॥
शशांकशतसंकाशः शातकौंभविभूषणः ॥ 28 ॥
1.4.m: There dwells the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, the god who bears a horse's head, / resembling a hundred moons, adorned with golden ornaments.

1.4.s:
puraṃ tatraiva vikhyātaṃ garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ ..
(prahrādasyāsurendrasya bāṣkaleśca mahātmanaḥ) .. 29 ..
1.4.d:
पुरं तत्रैव विख्यातं गरुडस्य महात्मनः ॥
(प्रह्रादस्यासुरेन्द्रस्य बाष्कलेश्च महात्मनः) ॥ 29 ॥
1.4.m: There indeed is the renowned city of the great-souled Garuḍa, / [and] of Prahrāda, lord of the Asuras, and of the great-souled Bāṣkali.

1.4.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
mahā taleti vikhyāto raktabhaumastupañcamaḥ .. 1.4.30 ..
1.4.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
महा तलेति विख्यातो रक्तभौमस्तुपञ्चमः ॥ 1.4.30 ॥
1.4.m: Above that is another of the very same extent: / the fifth, known as Mahātala, having red earth.

1.4.s:
sarovaraṃ tasya madhye yojanānāṃ daśāyutam ..
jaṃgamājaṃgamaiḥ sarverjalajaiśca vivarjitam.. 31 ..
1.4.d:
सरोवरं तस्य मध्ये योजनानां दशायुतम् ॥
जंगमाजंगमैः सर्वेर्जलजैश्च विवर्जितम्॥ 31 ॥
1.4.m: In its middle is a lake measuring a hundred thousand yojanas, / devoid of all moving and unmoving water-born creatures.

1.4.s:
tatrārūpeṇa vasati kūrmarūpadharo hariḥ ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ .. 32 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रारूपेण वसति कूर्मरूपधरो हरिः ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥ 32 ॥
1.4.m: There Hari dwells formless, yet bearing the form of a tortoise. / Above that is another of the very same extent:

1.4.s:
ṣaṣṭhaścaiva mahārāja nāmnā bhīmatalastu saḥ ..
tatrāpi sarasī divyā yojanānāṃ śataṃ gatā ..
tasyāṃ ca vasate devo matsyarūpadharo hariḥ .. 33 ..
1.4.d:
षष्ठश्चैव महाराज नाम्ना भीमतलस्तु सः ॥
तत्रापि सरसी दिव्या योजनानां शतं गता ॥
तस्यां च वसते देवो मत्स्यरूपधरो हरिः ॥ 33 ॥
1.4.m: The sixth, O great king, by name Bhīmatala; / there too is a divine lake extending for a hundred yojanas, / and in it dwells the god Hari, bearing the form of a fish.

1.4.s:
saptamaḥ kṛṣṇabhaumastu nāmnā bhīmatalastu saḥ ..
tatrāste kapilo devo vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ .. 34 ..
1.4.d:
सप्तमः कृष्णभौमस्तु नाम्ना भीमतलस्तु सः ॥
तत्रास्ते कपिलो देवो वासुदेवः स्वयं प्रभुः ॥ 34 ॥
1.4.m: The seventh has black earth, by name Bhīmatala; / there dwells Kapila, the god, the lord Vāsudeva himself.

1.4.s:
tatrāśmanagaraṃ nāma varuṇasya puraṃ smṛtam ..
tathā dānavavīrāṇāṃ nagarāṇi pṛthakpṛthak ..35 ..
1.4.d:
तत्राश्मनगरं नाम वरुणस्य पुरं स्मृतम् ॥
तथा दानववीराणां नगराणि पृथक्पृथक् ॥35 ॥
1.4.m: There is remembered Varuṇa's city named Aśmanagara, / and likewise the separate cities of the Dānava heroes:

1.4.s:
virocanasya kumbhasya nikumbhasya harasya ca ..
śambarasya karālasya narakasya hayasya ca .. 36 ..
1.4.d:
विरोचनस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य हरस्य च ॥
शम्बरस्य करालस्य नरकस्य हयस्य च ॥ 36 ॥
1.4.m: of Virocana, of Kumbha, of Nikumbha and Hara, / of Śambara, of Karāla, of Naraka and Haya,

1.4.s:
hayagrīvasya sundasya ghasasya praghasasya ca ..
baleḥ puravaraṃ cātra yogīśasya tathāparam ..37..
1.4.d:
हयग्रीवस्य सुन्दस्य घसस्य प्रघसस्य च ॥
बलेः पुरवरं चात्र योगीशस्य तथापरम् ॥37॥
1.4.m: of Hayagrīva, of Sunda, of Ghasa and Praghasa, / and here is another excellent city of Bali, the master of yoga,

1.4.s:
yatrasthamenaṃ dadṛśe rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ..
tathā puravaraṃ tatra viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..38..
1.4.d:
यत्रस्थमेनं ददृशे रावणो लोकरावणः ॥
तथा पुरवरं तत्र विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥38॥
1.4.m: staying where Rāvaṇa, who makes the world wail, saw him; / and there is an excellent city of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendor,

1.4.s:
lakṣmīsahāyo yatrāste cāgneyāmbarasaṃvṛtaḥ ..
tisraḥ koṭyastu yatrāsya bhaktānāṃ sumahātmanām .. 39 ..
1.4.d:
लक्ष्मीसहायो यत्रास्ते चाग्नेयाम्बरसंवृतः ॥
तिस्रः कोट्यस्तु यत्रास्य भक्तानां सुमहात्मनाम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.4.m: where, accompanied by Lakṣmī, he sits clad in fire-colored garments, / and where thirty million of his devotees dwell—great-souled ones

1.4.s: śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇāṃ pītavāsasām ..1.4.40..
1.4.d: शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधारिणां पीतवाससाम् ॥1.4.40॥
1.4.m: holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, clad in yellow garments,

1.4.s:
nīlotpala savarṇānāṃ viṣṇoḥ sadṛśatejasām ..
viṣṇoḥ sutānāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ satataṃ bhūrivarcasām.. 41 ..
1.4.d:
नीलोत्पल सवर्णानां विष्णोः सदृशतेजसाम् ॥
विष्णोः सुतानां हृष्टानां सततं भूरिवर्चसाम्॥ 41 ॥
1.4.m: having the color of blue water-lilies, possessing luster equal to Viṣṇu’s, / the joyful sons of Viṣṇu, constantly full of immense radiance.

1.4.s:
tatrastho dṛṣṭavāndevo paulastyo rāvaṇaḥ purā ..
purī bhogavatī tatra tathā vāsukipālitā .. 42 ..
1.4.d:
तत्रस्थो दृष्टवान्देवो पौलस्त्यो रावणः पुरा ॥
पुरी भोगवती तत्र तथा वासुकिपालिता ॥ 42 ॥
1.4.m: Stationed there, the lordly Paulastya Rāvaṇa saw [him] long ago; / there is the city Bhogavatī, protected by Vāsuki,

1.4.s:
nāgānāṃ ca purāṇyatra tathaiva ca pṛthakpṛthak ..
padmasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasya viraktasya kurostathā .. 43 ..
1.4.d:
नागानां च पुराण्यत्र तथैव च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
पद्मस्य धृतराष्ट्रस्य विरक्तस्य कुरोस्तथा ॥ 43 ॥
1.4.m: and here are the separate cities of the Nāgas: / of Padma, of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, of Virakta and Kuru,

1.4.s:
takṣakasyailapatrasya tathā karkoṭakasya ca ..
dhanañjayasya śaṅkhasya tathaivāśvatarasya ca .. 44 ..
1.4.d:
तक्षकस्यैलपत्रस्य तथा कर्कोटकस्य च ॥
धनञ्जयस्य शङ्खस्य तथैवाश्वतरस्य च ॥ 44 ॥
1.4.m: of Takṣaka, of Elāpatra, and likewise of Karkoṭaka, / of Dhanañjaya, of Śaṅkha, and likewise of Aśvatara,

1.4.s:
kandalasya surāsasya sumukhasya gayasya ca ..
diśāṃ gajānāṃ ca tathā tatra sthānaṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 45 ..
1.4.d:
कन्दलस्य सुरासस्य सुमुखस्य गयस्य च ॥
दिशां गजानां च तथा तत्र स्थानं पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 45 ॥
1.4.m: of Kandala, of Surāsa, of Sumukha and Gaya; / and likewise the separate abode of the elephants of the directions is there,

1.4.s:
yeṣāṃ skaṃdhagatā bhūmiḥ saśailavanakānanā ..
virūpākṣasya nāgasya mahāpadmasya cāpyatha .. 46 ..
1.4.d:
येषां स्कंधगता भूमिः सशैलवनकानना ॥
विरूपाक्षस्य नागस्य महापद्मस्य चाप्यथ ॥ 46 ॥
1.4.m: on whose shoulders rests the earth with its mountains and forests; / and also of the Nāga Virūpākṣa, and of Mahāpadma,

1.4.s:
tathā sumanasaścātra rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ..
paścāyutaparīmāṇā bhūmiḥ sarveṣu pārthiva .. 47 ..
1.4.d:
तथा सुमनसश्चात्र रुद्रस्य च महात्मनः ॥
पश्चायुतपरीमाणा भूमिः सर्वेषु पार्थिव ॥ 47 ॥
1.4.m: and of Sumanas here, and of the great-souled Rudra. / The earth is stated to measure fifty thousand [yojanas] in all,

1.4.s:
pātāleṣu vinirdiṣṭā paṭhitāntaravartinī ..
aṇḍasyārdhamidaṃ proktamadhastāttu pramāṇataḥ .. 48 ..
1.4.d:
पातालेषु विनिर्दिष्टा पठितान्तरवर्तिनी ॥
अण्डस्यार्धमिदं प्रोक्तमधस्तात्तु प्रमाणतः ॥ 48 ॥
1.4.m: lying in the middle of those recited netherworlds, O protector of the earth. / This lower half of the cosmic egg has been told according to its measure:

1.4.s:
tisraḥ koṭyastu rājendra niyutāni tathā daśa ..
pañcānyāni mahīpāla bhūmi puṣṭyā mahānagha .. 49 ..
1.4.d:
तिस्रः कोट्यस्तु राजेन्द्र नियुतानि तथा दश ॥
पञ्चान्यानि महीपाल भूमि पुष्ट्या महानघ ॥ 49 ॥
1.4.m: thirty million and ten hundred-thousand, / and five others, O ruler of the earth, by the thickness of the earth, O greatly sinless one.

1.4.s:
pañcāyutaparīmāṇāḥ puṣṭirbhūmeḥ prakīrtitā ..
bhūmerathopariṣṭācca aṇḍasyārdhamathāparam ..
etāvadeva nirdiṣṭā bhūmipāla pramāṇataḥ .. 1.4.50 ..
1.4.d:
पञ्चायुतपरीमाणाः पुष्टिर्भूमेः प्रकीर्तिता ॥
भूमेरथोपरिष्टाच्च अण्डस्यार्धमथापरम् ॥
एतावदेव निर्दिष्टा भूमिपाल प्रमाणतः ॥ 1.4.50 ॥
1.4.m: The thickness of the earth is declared to measure fifty thousand [yojanas]. / And above the earth, the other half of the egg / is designated as just of this same extent, O protector of the earth.

1.4.s:
candrārkabhāsā rahitaṃ nṛvīra svayaṃ prabhedaṃ kathitaṃ mayaitat ..
pātālapūgaṃ vividhaṃ suramyaṃ śṛṇuṣva lokān gadato mamānyā n .. 51 ..
1.4.d:
चन्द्रार्कभासा रहितं नृवीर स्वयं प्रभेदं कथितं मयैतत् ॥
पातालपूगं विविधं सुरम्यं शृणुष्व लोकान् गदतो ममान्या न् ॥ 51 ॥
1.4.m: Devoid of the light of the sun and moon, O hero among men, this distinction has been spoken by me of my own accord; / having heard this manifold, charming group of netherworlds, listen to me speaking of the other worlds.

1.5.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhūrlokaḥ prathamo rājañśṛṇuṣva gadato mama ..
pātālena tu tattulyamūrdhvataḥ parikīrttitaḥ .. 1 ..
1.5.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
भूर्लोकः प्रथमो राजञ्शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥
पातालेन तु तत्तुल्यमूर्ध्वतः परिकीर्त्तितः ॥ 1 ॥
1.5.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The first is the Bhūrloka, O king; listen to me speaking of it: / it is proclaimed to be equal to the netherworld, extending upwards.

1.5.s:
vāyuskandhā vinirdiṣṭāste tu sapta mahātmabhiḥ ..
ekaikaṃ niyutāḥ paṃca yojanānāṃ prakīrtitam .. 2 ..
1.5.d:
वायुस्कन्धा विनिर्दिष्टास्ते तु सप्त महात्मभिः ॥
एकैकं नियुताः पंच योजनानां प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.5.m: Seven courses of the wind are designated by the great-souled ones; / each one is declared to be five hundred thousand yojanas.

1.5.s:
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭā manuṣyāḥ kinnarāstathā ..
yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācā bhūmigocarāḥ ..3..
1.5.d:
पशवः पक्षिणः कीटा मनुष्याः किन्नरास्तथा ॥
यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वाः पिशाचा भूमिगोचराः ॥3॥
1.5.m: Beasts, birds, insects, human beings, and Kinnaras, / Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, Gandharvas, Piśācas dwelling on the earth—

1.5.s:
sarva ete vinirdiṣṭā annādā bhūmigocarāḥ ..
vidyādharāṇāṃ prathamaṃ vāyumārgaḥ prakīrttitaḥ .. 4 ..
1.5.d:
सर्व एते विनिर्दिष्टा अन्नादा भूमिगोचराः ॥
विद्याधराणां प्रथमं वायुमार्गः प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 4 ॥
1.5.m: all these are designated as food-eaters dwelling on the earth. / The first wind-path is proclaimed to be of the Vidyādharas;

1.5.s:
dvitīyaḥ siddhavidyānāṃ tṛtīyastu garutmatām ..
caturtho vāyumārgastu gandharvāṇāṃ prakīrttitaḥ .. 5 ..
1.5.d:
द्वितीयः सिद्धविद्यानां तृतीयस्तु गरुत्मताम् ॥
चतुर्थो वायुमार्गस्तु गन्धर्वाणां प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 5 ॥
1.5.m: the second of the Siddhavidyās; the third of the birds; / the fourth wind-path is declared to be of the Gandharvas;

1.5.s:
vināyakāḥ pañcamagā ṣaṣṭhe ca kariṇāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ śīkaratoyena cāvaśyāyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ .. 6 ..
1.5.d:
विनायकाः पञ्चमगा षष्ठे च करिणां गणाः ॥
येषां शीकरतोयेन चावश्यायः प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 6 ॥
1.5.m: the Vināyakas move in the fifth; and in the sixth are the troops of elephants, / through whose spray-water hoarfrost is declared [to arise];

1.5.s:
saptame ca mahābhāga siddhāstiṣṭhaṃti yādava ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ..7..
1.5.d:
सप्तमे च महाभाग सिद्धास्तिष्ठंति यादव ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः॥7॥
1.5.m: and in the seventh, O highly fortunate Yādava, dwell the Siddhas. / Above that is another of the very same extent:

1.5.s:
bhuvarloka iti khyāto yatra tiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ ..
manvantarādhikāreṣu ye bhaviṣyā mahīpate .. 8 ..
1.5.d:
भुवर्लोक इति ख्यातो यत्र तिष्ठंति देवताः ॥
मन्वन्तराधिकारेषु ये भविष्या महीपते ॥ 8 ॥
1.5.m: Known as the Bhuvarloka, where dwell the deities / who will hold office in future Manvantaras, O ruler of the earth.

1.5.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
svarloko vasatiryatra prāyaśaḥ puṇyakarmaṇām .. 9 ..
1.5.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
स्वर्लोको वसतिर्यत्र प्रायशः पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.5.m: Above that is another of the very same extent: / Svarloka, where is mostly the dwelling of those of meritorious deeds,

1.5.s:
somapānāṃ ca devānāṃ śakrādīnāṃ mahīpate ..
maharlokasthitiryatra devatānāṃ mahātmanām .. 1.5.10 ..
1.5.d:
सोमपानां च देवानां शक्रादीनां महीपते ॥
महर्लोकस्थितिर्यत्र देवतानां महात्मनाम् ॥ 1.5.10 ॥
1.5.m: and of the soma-drinking gods headed by Śakra, O ruler of the earth. / Above that is the Maharloka, where is the station of the great-souled deities

1.5.s:
vinivṛttādhikārāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ nṛpasattama ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ .. 11 ..
1.5.d:
विनिवृत्ताधिकाराणां सिद्धानां नृपसत्तम ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥ 11 ॥
1.5.m: whose offices have ended, and of the Siddhas, O best of kings. / Above that is another of the very same extent:

1.5.s:
janalokaḥ sthitiryatra gavāṃ pārthivasattama ..
tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇo rātryāṃ yatra jīvāḥ samantataḥ .. 12 ..
1.5.d:
जनलोकः स्थितिर्यत्र गवां पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
तिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्मणो रात्र्यां यत्र जीवाः समन्ततः ॥ 12 ॥
1.5.m: Janaloka, where is the dwelling of cattle, O best of rulers of the earth, / and where living beings dwell on all sides during the night of Brahmā.

1.5.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
tapolokaḥ sthitiryatra prāṇeśānāṃ mahātmanām .. 13 ..
1.5.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
तपोलोकः स्थितिर्यत्र प्राणेशानां महात्मनाम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.5.m: Above that is another of the very same extent: / Tapoloka, where is the station of the great-souled lords of life-breaths.

1.5.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
satyalokaḥ sthitiryatra brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 14 ..
1.5.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
सत्यलोकः स्थितिर्यत्र ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः ॥ 14 ॥
1.5.m: Above that is another of the very same extent: / Satyaloka, where is the dwelling of Brahmā Parameṣṭhin.

1.5.s:
ityete kathitāḥ sapta tava lokā mahātmanām ..
etāvāneva saviturvicaranti marīcayaḥ .. 15 ..
1.5.d:
इत्येते कथिताः सप्त तव लोका महात्मनाम् ॥
एतावानेव सवितुर्विचरन्ति मरीचयः ॥ 15 ॥
1.5.m: Thus these seven worlds of the noble beings have been described to you. / Only this far do the rays of the sun range.

1.5.s:
eteṣu lokasaṃjñoktā tasmādeva manīṣibhiḥ ..
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ .. 16 ..
1.5.d:
एतेषु लोकसंज्ञोक्ता तस्मादेव मनीषिभिः ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥ 16 ॥
1.5.m: For that very reason, the term "world" (loka) was proclaimed for them by the wise. / Above that, by the very same measure,

1.5.s:
sthānaṃ rudrasya kathitaṃ rudratejovirājitam ..
brahmalokopariṣṭāttu rudraloko mahattamaḥ .. 17
1.5.d:
स्थानं रुद्रस्य कथितं रुद्रतेजोविराजितम् ॥
ब्रह्मलोकोपरिष्टात्तु रुद्रलोको महत्तमः ॥ 17
1.5.m: the abode of Rudra is said to be, radiant with the splendor of Rudra. / Above the world of Brahmā, indeed, is the supreme world of Rudra,

1.5.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pañcabhirnibiḍaṃ matam ..
ādityamandiraṃ proktaṃ yadetaddivi dṛśyate .. 18 ..
1.5.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि पञ्चभिर्निबिडं मतम् ॥
आदित्यमन्दिरं प्रोक्तं यदेतद्दिवि दृश्यते ॥ 18 ॥
1.5.m: considered to be dense across five thousand yojanas. / The mansion of the sun is declared to be that which is seen in the sky.

1.5.s:
yadetaddṛśyate nīlaṃ tamastatpṛthivīpate ..
tamasastu pare pāre rudralokaḥ svayaṃ prabho .. 19 ..
1.5.d:
यदेतद्दृश्यते नीलं तमस्तत्पृथिवीपते ॥
तमसस्तु परे पारे रुद्रलोकः स्वयं प्रभो ॥ 19 ॥
1.5.m: That darkness which is seen as blue, O lord of the earth— / on the far shore of that darkness is the world of Rudra itself, O lord.

1.5.s:
rudratvaṃ samanuprāptaistatra bhaktairmahānagha ..
krīḍannāste mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 1.5.20 ..
1.5.d:
रुद्रत्वं समनुप्राप्तैस्तत्र भक्तैर्महानघ ॥
क्रीडन्नास्ते महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः ॥ 1.5.20 ॥
1.5.m: There, with his devotees who have attained the state of Rudra, O highly sinless one, / Mahādeva, whose banner is the bull, abides sporting together with his wife.

1.5.s:
tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ..
agamyassarvadevānāṃ viṣṇulokaḥ prakīrttitaḥ .. 21 ..
1.5.d:
तस्योपरिष्टादपरस्तावदेव प्रमाणतः ॥
अगम्यस्सर्वदेवानां विष्णुलोकः प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥ 21 ॥
1.5.m: Above that, by the very same measure, / is proclaimed the world of Viṣṇu, inaccessible to all the gods.

1.5.s:
tasyopariṣṭādbrahmāṇḍaḥ kāñcano dīptisaṃyutaḥ ..
bhuvarloke tu vasatirvāmanasya mahātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
1.5.d:
तस्योपरिष्टाद्ब्रह्माण्डः काञ्चनो दीप्तिसंयुतः ॥
भुवर्लोके तु वसतिर्वामनस्य महात्मनः ॥ 22 ॥
1.5.m: Above that is the golden cosmic egg endowed with brilliance. / In Bhuvarloka is the dwelling of the noble Vāmana;

1.5.s:
svarloke vasatirviṣṇorvaikuṇṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ..
nṛvarāhasya vasatirmaharloke prakīrtitā .. 23 ..
1.5.d:
स्वर्लोके वसतिर्विष्णोर्वैकुण्ठस्य महात्मनः ॥
नृवराहस्य वसतिर्महर्लोके प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 23 ॥
1.5.m: in Svarloka is the dwelling of noble Viṣṇu Vaikuṇṭha; / in Maharloka is proclaimed the dwelling of the Man-Boar;

1.5.s:
nṛsiṃhasya tathā proktā janaloke mahātmanaḥ ..
trivikramasya vasatistapoloke prakīrtitā .. 24 ..
1.5.d:
नृसिंहस्य तथा प्रोक्ता जनलोके महात्मनः ॥
त्रिविक्रमस्य वसतिस्तपोलोके प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 24 ॥
1.5.m: in Janaloka, likewise, is stated that of the noble Nṛsiṃha; / in Tapoloka is proclaimed the dwelling of Trivikrama.

1.5.s:
lokāḥ santānakā nāma satyaloke prakīrttitāḥ ..
eteṣu devaṃ paśyanti devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ .. 25 ..
1.5.d:
लोकाः सन्तानका नाम सत्यलोके प्रकीर्त्तिताः ॥
एतेषु देवं पश्यन्ति देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः ॥ 25 ॥
1.5.m: The worlds called Santānaka are proclaimed to be in Satyaloka; / in these the gods, headed by Indra, see the God.

1.5.s:
tapasā mahatā rājan bhaktāśca satataṃ prabhum ..
rudrasthānopariṣṭāttu viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ mayoditam .. 26 ..
1.5.d:
तपसा महता राजन् भक्ताश्च सततं प्रभुम् ॥
रुद्रस्थानोपरिष्टात्तु विष्णोः स्थानं मयोदितम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.5.m: Through great asceticism, O king, his devotees also constantly see the Lord. / Above the abode of Rudra, indeed, the abode of Viṣṇu has been described by me.

1.5.s:
na kaścidenaṃ śaknoti draṣṭuṃ devavaraṃ harim ..
na tatra sūryastapati candramā na virājate .. 27 ..
1.5.d:
न कश्चिदेनं शक्नोति द्रष्टुं देववरं हरिम् ॥
न तत्र सूर्यस्तपति चन्द्रमा न विराजते ॥ 27 ॥
1.5.m: No one is able to see him, Hari, the best of the gods. / There the sun does not burn, nor does the moon shine;

1.5.s:
tejasā tasya devasya sa tu deśo virājate ..
tasyopariṣṭādārabhya yāvadantaṃ mahīpate .. 28 ..
1.5.d:
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य स तु देशो विराजते ॥
तस्योपरिष्टादारभ्य यावदन्तं महीपते ॥ 28 ॥
1.5.m: that region shines solely by the splendor of that God. / Beginning from above that, O lord of the earth, as far as the end,

1.5.s:
proktaṃ varāhasthānasya tatra mānaṃ nibodha me ..
yojanānāṃ ca ṣaṭkoṭyastriṃśacca niyutānyatha .. 29 ..
1.5.d:
प्रोक्तं वराहस्थानस्य तत्र मानं निबोध मे ॥
योजनानां च षट्कोट्यस्त्रिंशच्च नियुतान्यथ ॥ 29 ॥
1.5.m: is proclaimed the abode of the Boar; learn from me its measure there: / sixty crores and thirty hundred-thousands of yojanas.

1.5.s:
etāvaccaiva bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ parikīrtitā ..
etāvadeva candrasya talamuktaṃ samaṃtataḥ .. 1.5.30 ..
1.5.d:
एतावच्चैव भूतानां वसतिः परिकीर्तिता ॥
एतावदेव चन्द्रस्य तलमुक्तं समंततः ॥ 1.5.30 ॥
1.5.m: And just so extensive is proclaimed to be the dwelling of living beings; / exactly of such measure is the surface of the moon declared to be all around.

1.5.s:
eteṣu devaṃ paśyanti devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ ..
tapasā mahatā rājan bhaktāśca satataṃ prabhum .. 31 ..
1.5.d:
एतेषु देवं पश्यन्ति देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः ॥
तपसा महता राजन् भक्ताश्च सततं प्रभुम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.5.m: In these [regions] the gods, headed by Indra, see the God, / and his devotees, through great asceticism, constantly see the Lord, O king.

1.5.s:
bāhyato'ṇḍaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tvadbhistu parivāritam ..
āpo daśaguṇenaiva bāhyatastejasā vṛtāḥ .. 32 ..
1.5.d:
बाह्यतोऽण्डं दशगुणं त्वद्भिस्तु परिवारितम् ॥
आपो दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतस्तेजसा वृताः ॥ 32 ॥
1.5.m: From the outside, the egg is surrounded by water, tenfold [in extent]; / the waters are enclosed from the outside by fire, tenfold [in extent];

1.5.s:
tejodaśaguṇenaiva bāhyataḥ pavanena ca ..
vāyurdaśaguṇenaiva gaganena tathāvṛtaḥ .. 33 ..
1.5.d:
तेजोदशगुणेनैव बाह्यतः पवनेन च ॥
वायुर्दशगुणेनैव गगनेन तथावृतः ॥ 33 ॥
1.5.m: fire by wind, tenfold [in extent] on the outside; / wind is likewise enclosed by space, tenfold [in extent];

1.5.s:
ākāśaṃ ca daśaghnena manasā bāhyato vṛtam..
manaśca buddhyā sakalaṃ vṛtaṃ rājan daśaghnayā..34..
1.5.d:
आकाशं च दशघ्नेन मनसा बाह्यतो वृतम्॥
मनश्च बुद्ध्या सकलं वृतं राजन् दशघ्नया॥34॥
1.5.m: and space is enclosed from the outside by mind, multiplied by ten; / and mind is completely enclosed by intellect, O king, multiplied by ten;

1.5.s:
ātmanā cāvṛtā buddhirdaśaghnena samantataḥ..
avyaktena tathaivātmā daśaghnenaiva cāvṛtaḥ ..35..
1.5.d:
आत्मना चावृता बुद्धिर्दशघ्नेन समन्ततः॥
अव्यक्तेन तथैवात्मा दशघ्नेनैव चावृतः ॥35॥
1.5.m: intellect is enclosed on all sides by the self, multiplied by ten; / and likewise the self is enclosed by the unmanifest, multiplied by ten.

1.5.s:
avyaktaḥ puruṣeṇātha tvanantenāvṛto'nagha ..
evaṃ vidhānāmaṇḍānāmavyaktaḥ puruṣottamaḥ .. 36..
1.5.d:
अव्यक्तः पुरुषेणाथ त्वनन्तेनावृतोऽनघ ॥
एवं विधानामण्डानामव्यक्तः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ 36॥
1.5.m: The unmanifest is then enclosed by the infinite Cosmic Person, O sinless one. / Puruṣottama is unmanifest in relation to eggs of such kinds.

1.5.s:
tiryyagūrdhvamadhaḥ saṃkhyā vaktuṃ rājanna śakyate ..
anantatvātpradhānasya puruṣasya mahātmanaḥ ..37..
1.5.d:
तिर्य्यगूर्ध्वमधः संख्या वक्तुं राजन्न शक्यते ॥
अनन्तत्वात्प्रधानस्य पुरुषस्य महात्मनः ॥37॥
1.5.m: Their number horizontally, above, and below cannot be spoken, O king, / because of the infinitude of the Pradhāna and of the noble Cosmic Person.

1.5.s:
ekarūpāstathaivāṇḍāḥ sarva eva narādhipa ..
tulyadeśavibhāgaśca tulyajantava eva ca ..38..
1.5.d:
एकरूपास्तथैवाण्डाः सर्व एव नराधिप ॥
तुल्यदेशविभागश्च तुल्यजन्तव एव च ॥38॥
1.5.m: All the eggs are of identical form, O lord of men, / with equal divisions of lands and equal creatures;

1.5.s:
deśedeśe samānā ye aṇḍeṣu nṛpasattama ..
sukhaduḥkhe same teṣāṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ..39..
1.5.d:
देशेदेशे समाना ये अण्डेषु नृपसत्तम ॥
सुखदुःखे समे तेषां जीवितं मरणं तथा ॥39॥
1.5.m: those who are identical in each region across the eggs, O best of kings, / their pleasure and pain are equal, as are their life and death.

1.5.s:
sarvāṇḍānāṃ samā jñeyā kālasaṃkhyā narādhipa ..
pauruṣasya dinasyānte sarve hyaṇḍanivāsinaḥ .. 1.5.40 ..
1.5.d:
सर्वाण्डानां समा ज्ञेया कालसंख्या नराधिप ॥
पौरुषस्य दिनस्यान्ते सर्वे ह्यण्डनिवासिनः ॥ 1.5.40 ॥
1.5.m: The reckoning of time across all eggs is to be known as equal, O lord of men; / at the end of the day of the Cosmic Person, all the inhabitants of the eggs [perish].

1.5.s:
eko'pyananto rājendra nāntareva prakīrtitaḥ ..
ayaṃ mayokto nṛpa sanniveśaḥ saṃkṣepamātreṇa carācarasya ..
vyāsena caivaṃ parikīrtyamānaḥ samāpyate naiva kadācideva .. 41 ..
1.5.d:
एकोऽप्यनन्तो राजेन्द्र नान्तरेव प्रकीर्तितः ॥
अयं मयोक्तो नृप सन्निवेशः संक्षेपमात्रेण चराचरस्य ॥
व्यासेन चैवं परिकीर्त्यमानः समाप्यते नैव कदाचिदेव ॥ 41 ॥
1.5.m: Even being one, he is infinite, O king of kings; he is proclaimed without end. / This arrangement of the moving and unmoving world has been stated by me in brief, O king; / even if proclaimed at full length, it would never come to an end.

1.6.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
bhūmaṇḍalasya kṛtsnasya saṃsthānena ca bhārgava ..
vada pramāṇaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tattatra me saṃśayo mahān ..1..
1.6.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
भूमण्डलस्य कृत्स्नस्य संस्थानेन च भार्गव ॥
वद प्रमाणं कृत्स्नं तत्तत्र मे संशयो महान् ॥1॥
1.6.m: Vajra said: / Concerning the entire terrestrial sphere, O descendant of Bhṛgu, in its arrangement, / tell me its entire measurement, for I have great doubt in that matter.

1.6.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhūmaṇḍalasya rājendra madhye merurmahāgiriḥ ..
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi tasya madhye samantataḥ ..2..
1.6.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
भूमण्डलस्य राजेन्द्र मध्ये मेरुर्महागिरिः ॥
योजनानां सहस्राणि तस्य मध्ये समन्ततः ॥2॥
1.6.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the center of the terrestrial sphere, O king of kings, stands the great mountain Meru; / in its middle, on all sides, [reaching] thousands of yojanas,

1.6.s:
jambūdvīpastu pañcāśatpramāṇena prakīrtitaḥ ..
yojanānāṃ tu niyutaṃ tasya pāraṃ mahīpate .. 3 ..
1.6.d:
जम्बूद्वीपस्तु पञ्चाशत्प्रमाणेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥
योजनानां तु नियुतं तस्य पारं महीपते ॥ 3 ॥
1.6.m: Jambūdvīpa is proclaimed to be fifty [thousand yojanas] in extent. / Its outer limit is a hundred thousand yojanas, O lord of the earth.

1.6.s:
lavaṇena samudreṇa tenāsau pariveṣṭitaḥ ..
lavaṇadviguṇenāpi śākadvīpena lāvaṇaḥ ..4..
1.6.d:
लवणेन समुद्रेण तेनासौ परिवेष्टितः ॥
लवणद्विगुणेनापि शाकद्वीपेन लावणः ॥4॥
1.6.m: It is surrounded by the salt ocean. / The salt ocean is surrounded by Śākadvīpa, twice the size of the salt ocean;

1.6.s:
veṣṭitaśca mahārāja śākadvīpo na saṃśayaḥ ..
kṣīrodena svatulyena kṣīrodo'pi ca veṣṭitaḥ .. 5 ..
1.6.d:
वेष्टितश्च महाराज शाकद्वीपो न संशयः ॥
क्षीरोदेन स्वतुल्येन क्षीरोदोऽपि च वेष्टितः ॥ 5 ॥
1.6.m: and Śākadvīpa is surrounded, O great king, without doubt, / by the ocean of milk, equal to itself; and the ocean of milk is surrounded

1.6.s:
kṣīrodadviguṇenāpi kuśadvīpena yojanaiḥ ..
ājyodena kuśadvīpaḥ svatulyena ca veṣṭitaḥ .. 6..
1.6.d:
क्षीरोदद्विगुणेनापि कुशद्वीपेन योजनैः ॥
आज्योदेन कुशद्वीपः स्वतुल्येन च वेष्टितः ॥ 6॥
1.6.m: by Kuśadvīpa, twice the size in yojanas of the ocean of milk. / Kuśadvīpa is surrounded by the ocean of clarified butter, equal to itself;

1.6.s:
krauñcadvīpena cājyodo dviguṇena ca veṣṭitaḥ ..
krauñcadvīpaḥ svatulyena dadhimaṇḍodakena ca .. 7 ..
1.6.d:
क्रौञ्चद्वीपेन चाज्योदो द्विगुणेन च वेष्टितः ॥
क्रौञ्चद्वीपः स्वतुल्येन दधिमण्डोदकेन च ॥ 7 ॥
1.6.m: and the ocean of clarified butter is surrounded by Krauñcadvīpa, twice its size. / Krauñcadvīpa is surrounded by the ocean of curd-whey, equal to itself;

1.6.s:
dvīpena śālmalenātha dviguṇena ca veṣṭitaḥ ..
surodo dviguṇenātha gomedena ca veṣṭitaḥ .. 8 ..
1.6.d:
द्वीपेन शाल्मलेनाथ द्विगुणेन च वेष्टितः ॥
सुरोदो द्विगुणेनाथ गोमेदेन च वेष्टितः ॥ 8 ॥
1.6.m: then by Śālmaladvīpa, twice its size, it is surrounded. / The ocean of wine is surrounded by Gomedadvīpa, twice its size.

1.6.s:
puṣkaradvīpamadhye tu dvīpasaṃsthānamaṇḍapaḥ ..
parvataḥ sumahām̐lloke vikhyāto mānasottaraḥ .. 9 ..
1.6.d:
पुष्करद्वीपमध्ये तु द्वीपसंस्थानमण्डपः ॥
पर्वतः सुमहाम्̐ल्लोके विख्यातो मानसोत्तरः ॥ 9 ॥
1.6.m: In the middle of Puṣkaradvīpa stands an open hall in the form of an island, / a very great mountain renowned in the world as Mānasottara.

1.6.s:
niyutārdhaṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇena prakīrtitaḥ ..
nānāprakāraśikharastāvadeva samucchritaḥ .. 1.6.10 ..
1.6.d:
नियुतार्धं योजनानां प्रमाणेन प्रकीर्तितः ॥
नानाप्रकारशिखरस्तावदेव समुच्छ्रितः ॥ 1.6.10 ॥
1.6.m: It is proclaimed to be half a hundred thousand yojanas in measurement, / having various kinds of peaks, and rising just as high.

1.6.s:
merostu pūrvadigbhāge mānasottaramūrdhani ..
purī śakrasya vikhyātā nāmatastvamarāvatī .. 11 ..
1.6.d:
मेरोस्तु पूर्वदिग्भागे मानसोत्तरमूर्धनि ॥
पुरी शक्रस्य विख्याता नामतस्त्वमरावती ॥ 11 ॥
1.6.m: To the east of Meru, upon the summit of Mānasottara, / is the city of Śakra, renowned by the name of Amarāvatī.

1.6.s:
pūrvadakṣiṇadigbhāge tathā vahneḥ prabhāvatī ..
yamasya dakṣiṇe bhāge nāmnā saṃyamanī purī .. 12 ..
1.6.d:
पूर्वदक्षिणदिग्भागे तथा वह्नेः प्रभावती ॥
यमस्य दक्षिणे भागे नाम्ना संयमनी पुरी ॥ 12 ॥
1.6.m: In the south-eastern direction is Prabhāvatī of Agni; / in the southern quarter is the city of Yama named Saṃyamanī.

1.6.s:
virūpākṣasya vikrāntā bhāge dakṣiṇapaścime ..
paścime ca tathā bhāge varuṇasya sukhaprabhā .. 13 ..
1.6.d:
विरूपाक्षस्य विक्रान्ता भागे दक्षिणपश्चिमे ॥
पश्चिमे च तथा भागे वरुणस्य सुखप्रभा ॥ 13 ॥
1.6.m: In the south-western quarter is Vikrāntā of Virūpākṣa; / and in the western quarter is Sukhaprabhā of Varuṇa.

1.6.s:
śivā nāma purī vāyorbhāge vai paścimottare ..
vibhāvarī somapurī uttareṇa prakīrtitā .. 14 ..
1.6.d:
शिवा नाम पुरी वायोर्भागे वै पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥
विभावरी सोमपुरी उत्तरेण प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 14 ॥
1.6.m: The city named Śivā belongs to Vāyu in the north-western quarter; / Vibhāvarī, the city of Soma, is proclaimed in the north.

1.6.s:
śarmadā ca purī śaivī bhāge pūrvottare smṛtā ..
puṣkaraśca svatulyena vṛtaḥ svādūdakena ca .. 15 ..
1.6.d:
शर्मदा च पुरी शैवी भागे पूर्वोत्तरे स्मृता ॥
पुष्करश्च स्वतुल्येन वृतः स्वादूदकेन च ॥ 15 ॥
1.6.m: And Śarmadā, sacred to Śiva, is remembered in the north-eastern quarter. / Puṣkaradvīpa is surrounded by the ocean of fresh water, equal to itself.

1.6.s:
svādūdakātparaṃ kṣoṇī kārtasvaramayī śubhā ..
yojanānāṃ pramāṇena sahasrāṇi tu viṃśatiḥ .. 16 ..
1.6.d:
स्वादूदकात्परं क्षोणी कार्तस्वरमयी शुभा ॥
योजनानां प्रमाणेन सहस्राणि तु विंशतिः ॥ 16 ॥
1.6.m: Beyond the fresh water is the auspicious golden land, / measuring twenty thousand yojanas;

1.6.s:
daśa cānyāni rājendra pañca pañca prakīrtitā ..
samantatastvekaśilā devodyāne mahī śubhā .. 17 ..
1.6.d:
दश चान्यानि राजेन्द्र पञ्च पञ्च प्रकीर्तिता ॥
समन्ततस्त्वेकशिला देवोद्याने मही शुभा ॥ 17 ॥
1.6.m: and ten others, O king of kings, [measuring] five and five, are proclaimed. / The auspicious ground in the divine pleasure-garden is of a single stone all around.

1.6.s:
sthitastāṃ parivāryorvīṃ lokāloko mahīdharaḥ ..
ayutaṃ yojanānāṃ tu vistareṇocchrayeṇa ca .. 18 ..
1.6.d:
स्थितस्तां परिवार्योर्वीं लोकालोको महीधरः ॥
अयुतं योजनानां तु विस्तरेणोच्छ्रयेण च ॥ 18 ॥
1.6.m: Surrounding that earth stands the mountain Lokāloka, / ten thousand yojanas in breadth and in height.

1.6.s:
lokāloke mahīpāla lokapālāstvamī smṛtāḥ ..
prācyādiṣu mahāvīryāḥ kalpasthāyina eva te .. 19 ..
1.6.d:
लोकालोके महीपाल लोकपालास्त्वमी स्मृताः ॥
प्राच्यादिषु महावीर्याः कल्पस्थायिन एव ते ॥ 19 ॥
1.6.m: On Lokāloka, O protector of the earth, these are known as the world-guardians, / of great valour in the east and the other [directions], abiding for an entire aeon:

1.6.s:
sudāmā śeṣapādaśca ketumānsumahābalaḥ ..
hiraṇyaromā ca tathā vijñeyāśca digīśvarāḥ .. 1.6.20 ..
1.6.d:
सुदामा शेषपादश्च केतुमान्सुमहाबलः ॥
हिरण्यरोमा च तथा विज्ञेयाश्च दिगीश्वराः ॥ 1.6.20 ॥
1.6.m: Sudāman, Śeṣapāda, and the exceedingly powerful Ketumant, / and likewise Hiraṇyaroman: these are to be known as the lords of the directions.

1.6.s:
arvāktasya mahīdhrasya candrārka grahatārakāḥ ..
prapatanti mahārāja na tu pāre kadācana .. 21 ..
1.6.d:
अर्वाक्तस्य महीध्रस्य चन्द्रार्क ग्रहतारकाः ॥
प्रपतन्ति महाराज न तु पारे कदाचन ॥ 21 ॥
1.6.m: On the hither side of that mountain, the moon, sun, planets, and stars / move, O great king, but never beyond it.

1.6.s:
darbhodakasamudrastu lokālokaṃ samantataḥ ..
parivārya sthito rājannandhakāre mahārṇava .. 22 ..
1.6.d:
दर्भोदकसमुद्रस्तु लोकालोकं समन्ततः ॥
परिवार्य स्थितो राजन्नन्धकारे महार्णव ॥ 22 ॥
1.6.m: The ocean of water with darbha-grass, O king, stands surrounding / Lokāloka on all sides—a great ocean in darkness.

1.6.s:
ekaṣaṣṭipramāṇena niyutāni samantataḥ ..
tasya pāre tato rājanbrahmāṇḍastu samantataḥ .. 23 ..
1.6.d:
एकषष्टिप्रमाणेन नियुतानि समन्ततः ॥
तस्य पारे ततो राजन्ब्रह्माण्डस्तु समन्ततः ॥ 23 ॥
1.6.m: Its measure is sixty-one hundred-thousand [yojanas] on all sides. / Beyond it, O king, lies the cosmic egg on every side.

1.6.s:
ūrddhvenādhaśca viṣkambho yāvānaṇḍasya kīrtitaḥ ..
tāvadeva pramāṇena tiryakṣu parivāritaḥ .. 24 ..
1.6.d:
ऊर्द्ध्वेनाधश्च विष्कम्भो यावानण्डस्य कीर्तितः ॥
तावदेव प्रमाणेन तिर्यक्षु परिवारितः ॥ 24 ॥
1.6.m: As great as the diameter of the egg is proclaimed to be above and below, / by just that measure is it encompassed horizontally.

1.6.s:
merumadhyātsamudrasya pāraṃ garbhodakasya tu ..
koṭitrayaṃ yojanānāṃ niyutāni tathā daśa .. 25 ..
1.6.d:
मेरुमध्यात्समुद्रस्य पारं गर्भोदकस्य तु ॥
कोटित्रयं योजनानां नियुतानि तथा दश ॥ 25 ॥
1.6.m: From the middle of Meru to the far shore of the ocean of primal waters / is thirty million yojanas and one million,

1.6.s:
pañcānyāni ca rājendra pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam ..
tasya rāja... brahmāṇḍastu samantataḥ .. 26 ..
1.6.d:
पञ्चान्यानि च राजेन्द्र प्रमाणं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
तस्य राज॥। ब्रह्माण्डस्तु समन्ततः ॥ 26 ॥
1.6.m: and five others [hundred-thousand], O king of kings, is proclaimed to be the measure. / [...] of that, O king, is the cosmic egg on all sides.

1.6.s:
....tadadyardhaṃ dvitīyasya mahīpate . ..
etadeva tu nirdiṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ tattvacintakaiḥ .. 27 ..
1.6.d:
॥॥तदद्यर्धं द्वितीयस्य महीपते ॥।
एतदेव तु निर्दिष्टं प्रमाणं तत्त्वचिन्तकैः ॥ 27 ॥
1.6.m: [...] one and a half times that of the second, O protector of the earth. / Just this is the measure pointed out by those who contemplate reality.

1.6.s:
merostu pūrvadigbhāge madhye tu lavaṇodadheḥ ..
viṣṇuloko mahānproktaḥ salilāntara saṃsthitam..28..
1.6.d:
मेरोस्तु पूर्वदिग्भागे मध्ये तु लवणोदधेः ॥
विष्णुलोको महान्प्रोक्तः सलिलान्तर संस्थितम्॥28॥
1.6.m: To the east of Meru, in the midst of the Salt Ocean, / the great world of Viṣṇu is proclaimed, situated within the waters,

1.6.s:
svabhāsayātra devasya satataṃ nṛpa rājitam ..
tatra svapiti gharmānte devadevo janārdanaḥ .. 29 ..
1.6.d:
स्वभासयात्र देवस्य सततं नृप राजितम् ॥
तत्र स्वपिति घर्मान्ते देवदेवो जनार्दनः ॥ 29 ॥
1.6.m: always radiant, O king, with the radiance of the god himself. / There sleeps Janārdana, the god of gods, at the close of the hot season,

1.6.s:
lakṣyīsahāyaḥ satataṃ śeṣaparyaṅkamāśritaḥ ..
ekādaśyāmāṣāḍhasya śuklapakṣe janārdanam .. 1.6.30 ..
1.6.d:
लक्ष्यीसहायः सततं शेषपर्यङ्कमाश्रितः ॥
एकादश्यामाषाढस्य शुक्लपक्षे जनार्दनम् ॥ 1.6.30 ॥
1.6.m: ever accompanied by Lakṣmī, resting upon the couch of Śeṣa. / On the eleventh [day] of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha,

1.6.s:
devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
abhiṣṭuvanti te gatvā satataṃ dinapañcakam .. 31..
1.6.d:
देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः ॥
अभिष्टुवन्ति ते गत्वा सततं दिनपञ्चकम् ॥ 31॥
1.6.m: the gods, the sages, and the hosts of gandharvas and apsarases / go and continuously praise Janārdana for five days,

1.6.s:
utsavaṃ caiva kurvanti gītanṛtyasamākulam..
tatastu caturo māsānyoganidrāmupāsate ..32..
1.6.d:
उत्सवं चैव कुर्वन्ति गीतनृत्यसमाकुलम्॥
ततस्तु चतुरो मासान्योगनिद्रामुपासते ॥32॥
1.6.m: and make a festival filled with song and dance. / Then for four months they revere his yogic sleep.

1.6.s:
suptaṃ ca tamupāsaṃte ṛṣayo brahmasammatāḥ ..
saśarīrāṇi śāstrāṇi bhaktāstaṃ devamānavāḥ ..33..
1.6.d:
सुप्तं च तमुपासंते ऋषयो ब्रह्मसम्मताः ॥
सशरीराणि शास्त्राणि भक्तास्तं देवमानवाः ॥33॥
1.6.m: And while he sleeps, sages approved by Brahmā attend upon him, / [as do] the scriptures in bodily form and human beings devoted to that god.

1.6.s:
kārtikasya site pakṣe tadeva dinapañcakam ..
vibodhayanti deveśaṃ gatvā sendrā divaukasaḥ ..34..
1.6.d:
कार्तिकस्य सिते पक्षे तदेव दिनपञ्चकम् ॥
विबोधयन्ति देवेशं गत्वा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः ॥34॥
1.6.m: In the bright fortnight of Kārtika, for those same five days, / the sky-dwellers headed by Indra go and awaken the lord of gods.

1.6.s:
devāstathaiva kurvanti tadāpi ca mahotsavam..
merostu pūrvadigbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu ..35..
1.6.d:
देवास्तथैव कुर्वन्ति तदापि च महोत्सवम्॥
मेरोस्तु पूर्वदिग्भागे मध्ये क्षीरार्णवस्य तु ॥35॥
1.6.m: Then too the gods make a great festival in the very same way. / To the east of Meru, in the midst of the Ocean of Milk,

1.6.s:
kṣīrāmbumadhyagā śubhrā devasyānyā tathā purī ..
lakṣmī sahāyastatrāste śeṣāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ ..36..
1.6.d:
क्षीराम्बुमध्यगा शुभ्रा देवस्यान्या तथा पुरी ॥
लक्ष्मी सहायस्तत्रास्ते शेषासनगतः प्रभुः ॥36॥
1.6.m: there is another radiant city of the god, situated in the midst of the milk-waters. / Accompanied by Lakṣmī, the lord sits there, seated upon Śeṣa.

1.6.s:
tatrāpi caturo māsān suptastiṣṭhati vārṣikān ..
astraiḥ sa kevalaistatra dṛśyate śāśvataḥ prabhuḥ .. 37 ..
1.6.d:
तत्रापि चतुरो मासान् सुप्तस्तिष्ठति वार्षिकान् ॥
अस्त्रैः स केवलैस्तत्र दृश्यते शाश्वतः प्रभुः ॥ 37 ॥
1.6.m: There too he remains asleep for the four months of the rainy season. / There the eternal lord is beheld accompanied only by his weapons.

1.6.s:
tasmiṃstathaiva digbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu ..
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi maṇḍalaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ .. 38..
1.6.d:
तस्मिंस्तथैव दिग्भागे मध्ये क्षीरार्णवस्य तु ॥
योजनानां सहस्राणि मण्डलः पञ्चविंशतिः ॥ 38॥
1.6.m: In that same direction, in the midst of the Ocean of Milk, / is a circle of twenty-five thousand yojanas,

1.6.s:
śvetadīpastu vikhyāto dvīpaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ ..
narāḥ sūryaprabhāstatra śītāṃśusamadarśanāḥ ..39..
1.6.d:
श्वेतदीपस्तु विख्यातो द्वीपः परमशोभनः ॥
नराः सूर्यप्रभास्तत्र शीतांशुसमदर्शनाः ॥39॥
1.6.m: known as Śvetadvīpa, an exceedingly lovely island. / The men there have the splendour of the sun and look like the cool-rayed moon.

1.6.s:
tejasā durnirīkṣyāśca devānāmapi yādava ..
pañcakālavidhānajñāḥ pūjayanti janārdanam .. 1.6.40 ..
1.6.d:
तेजसा दुर्निरीक्ष्याश्च देवानामपि यादव ॥
पञ्चकालविधानज्ञाः पूजयन्ति जनार्दनम् ॥ 1.6.40 ॥
1.6.m: Difficult to look upon because of their brilliance even for the gods, O descendant of Yadu, / knowing the rules of the five periods of time, they worship Janārdana.

1.6.s:
pūjāṃ tu teṣāṃ śirasā sa tu devaḥ prayacchati ..
ihasthaiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ pādataśca prayacchati..41..
1.6.d:
पूजां तु तेषां शिरसा स तु देवः प्रयच्छति ॥
इहस्थैश्च कृतां पूजां पादतश्च प्रयच्छति॥41॥
1.6.m: And that god receives their worship with his head; / but the worship made by those who dwell here, he receives with his feet.

1.6.s:
ekāntabhāvopagatāstatra yānti hariṃ narāḥ ..
tatra gatvā na śocanti nivarttante na cāpyatha..42..
1.6.d:
एकान्तभावोपगतास्तत्र यान्ति हरिं नराः ॥
तत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति निवर्त्तन्ते न चाप्यथ॥42॥
1.6.m: Men who have attained single-minded devotion go there to Hari. / Having gone there, they do not grieve, nor do they ever return.

1.6.s:
pūjayitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam..
ādityamaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā brahmāṇaṃ praviśanti te..43..
1.6.d:
पूजयित्वा चिरं कालं देवदेवं जनार्दनम्॥
आदित्यमण्डलं भित्त्वा ब्रह्माणं प्रविशन्ति ते॥43॥
1.6.m: Having worshiped Janārdana, the god of gods, for a long time, / they pierce through the orb of the sun and enter Brahmā;

1.6.s:
tato'niruddhaṃ deveśaṃ pradyumnaṃ cāpyanantaram ..
tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ tataḥ param .. 44 ..
1.6.d:
ततोऽनिरुद्धं देवेशं प्रद्युम्नं चाप्यनन्तरम् ॥
ततः संकर्षणं देवं वासुदेवं ततः परम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.6.m: then Aniruddha, the lord of gods, and immediately after Pradyumna; / then the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, and beyond him Vāsudeva.

1.6.s:
vāsudevaṃ ca saṃprāpya mucyante sarvavarttanaiḥ ..
śvetadvīpagatāstasmānna nivartanti karhicit ..45 ..
1.6.d:
वासुदेवं च संप्राप्य मुच्यन्ते सर्ववर्त्तनैः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपगतास्तस्मान्न निवर्तन्ति कर्हिचित् ॥45 ॥
1.6.m: And having reached Vāsudeva, they are freed from all transmigrations. / Therefore those who have reached Śvetadvīpa never return.

1.6.s:
pūrvottare tu digbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu ..
vaijayanta iti khyātaḥ parvataḥ sarvakāñcanaḥ .. 46 ..
1.6.d:
पूर्वोत्तरे तु दिग्भागे मध्ये क्षीरार्णवस्य तु ॥
वैजयन्त इति ख्यातः पर्वतः सर्वकाञ्चनः ॥ 46 ॥
1.6.m: In the north-eastern direction, in the midst of the Ocean of Milk, / is a mountain entirely of gold, known as Vaijayanta.

1.6.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pramāṇena daśa smṛtaḥ ..
āyāmavistarocchrāyaiḥ pramāṇaṃ tasya kīrtitam ..47..
1.6.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि प्रमाणेन दश स्मृतः ॥
आयामविस्तरोच्छ्रायैः प्रमाणं तस्य कीर्तितम् ॥47॥
1.6.m: It is taught to measure ten thousand yojanas; / its measure is proclaimed in length, breadth, and height.

1.6.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pañca tasya guhā smṛtā..
ucchritā yojanaśataṃ tāvadeva ca vistṛtā .. 48 ..
1.6.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि पञ्च तस्य गुहा स्मृता॥
उच्छ्रिता योजनशतं तावदेव च विस्तृता ॥ 48 ॥
1.6.m: Its cave is taught to be five thousand yojanas [deep], / a hundred yojanas high and just as broad.

1.6.s:
timireṇāvṛtā dvāri yojanānāṃ tathā śatam ..
svaprabhābharaṇā divyā tataḥ parataraṃ hi sā .. 49 ..
1.6.d:
तिमिरेणावृता द्वारि योजनानां तथा शतम् ॥
स्वप्रभाभरणा दिव्या ततः परतरं हि सा ॥ 49 ॥
1.6.m: At the entrance it is covered in darkness for a hundred yojanas; / but beyond that, it is divine, adorned by its own light,

1.6.s:
nāmnā ca loke vikhyātā ṛṣibhistimirāvatī ..
tasyāṃ devavaro viṣṇuḥ svapannāste janārdanaḥ ..1.6.50..
1.6.d:
नाम्ना च लोके विख्याता ऋषिभिस्तिमिरावती ॥
तस्यां देववरो विष्णुः स्वपन्नास्ते जनार्दनः ॥1.6.50॥
1.6.m: and renowned in the world among sages by the name Timirāvatī. / In it Janārdana Viṣṇu, the best of gods, remains asleep.

1.6.s:
tatrainamupatiṣṭhanti devyastisro mahīpate . ..
nidrā ca kālarātriśca lakṣmīśca varavarṇinī ..51..
1.6.d:
तत्रैनमुपतिष्ठन्ति देव्यस्तिस्रो महीपते ॥।
निद्रा च कालरात्रिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च वरवर्णिनी ॥51॥
1.6.m: There three goddesses attend upon him, O protector of the earth: / Sleep, Kālarātri, and the fair-complexioned Lakṣmī.

1.6.s:
upāsate ca taṃ devaṃ bhṛgvādyā paramarṣayaḥ ..
śarīradhāribhiścāstraistathā tatra ca sevyate ..52..
1.6.d:
उपासते च तं देवं भृग्वाद्या परमर्षयः ॥
शरीरधारिभिश्चास्त्रैस्तथा तत्र च सेव्यते ॥52॥
1.6.m: And the supreme sages, Bhṛgu and others, revere that god, / and he is served there likewise by his weapons bearing bodily form.

1.6.s:
tasya suptasya vadanānniśvāsocchvāsataḥ kramāt ..
prajānāṃ paṅktayo hyuccairnipatanti patanti ca .. 53 ..
1.6.d:
तस्य सुप्तस्य वदनान्निश्वासोच्छ्वासतः क्रमात् ॥
प्रजानां पङ्क्तयो ह्युच्चैर्निपतन्ति पतन्ति च ॥ 53 ॥
1.6.m: From the mouth of him who is asleep, by inhaling and exhaling in succession, / the ranks of creatures rise high and fall.

1.6.s:
tasyocchvāsaśca jantūnāṃ sambhavaḥ kathito nṛpa ..
niḥśvāsakāle ca tathā jantūnāṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtam .. 54 ..
1.6.d:
तस्योच्छ्वासश्च जन्तूनां सम्भवः कथितो नृप ॥
निःश्वासकाले च तथा जन्तूनां मरणं स्मृतम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.6.m: His inhalation is said to be the origination of living beings, O king; / and at the time of his exhalation, the death of living beings is remembered.

1.6.s:
madhye dhṛtasamudrasya meroḥ paścimatastathā ..
yojanānāṃ tu niyutaṃ dvīpastu parimaṇḍalaḥ..55..
1.6.d:
मध्ये धृतसमुद्रस्य मेरोः पश्चिमतस्तथा ॥
योजनानां तु नियुतं द्वीपस्तु परिमण्डलः॥55॥
1.6.m: In the midst of the Ocean of Ghee, west of Meru, / is a circular island of one hundred thousand yojanas.

1.6.s:
tatra govardhanasyoktā vasatiḥ sumahātmanaḥ ..
divyānāṃ tatra dhenūnāṃ vasatiśca tathā smṛtā .. 56 ..
1.6.d:
तत्र गोवर्धनस्योक्ता वसतिः सुमहात्मनः ॥
दिव्यानां तत्र धेनूनां वसतिश्च तथा स्मृता ॥ 56 ॥
1.6.m: There the abode of the great-souled Govardhana is spoken of, / and there the abode of the divine cows is likewise remembered.

1.6.s:
satataṃ kāmarūpeṇa bhābhiḥ sa ramate hariḥ ..
madhye dadhisamudrasya dvīpastāvatpramāṇataḥ .. 57 ..
1.6.d:
सततं कामरूपेण भाभिः स रमते हरिः ॥
मध्ये दधिसमुद्रस्य द्वीपस्तावत्प्रमाणतः ॥ 57 ॥
1.6.m: There Hari constantly takes delight at will with the splendours [of the cows]. / In the midst of the Ocean of Curds is an island of the same measure,

1.6.s:
hemarūpadharo yatra nityaṃ vasati keśavaḥ ..
tatrasthamenaṃ paśyanti ṛṣayo bhūritejasaḥ .. 58 ..
1.6.d:
हेमरूपधरो यत्र नित्यं वसति केशवः ॥
तत्रस्थमेनं पश्यन्ति ऋषयो भूरितेजसः ॥ 58 ॥
1.6.m: where Keśava, bearing a golden form, dwells eternally. / Sages of abundant radiance behold him dwelling there.

1.6.s:
surāsamudramadhye tu dvīpaḥ paramavistṛtaḥ ..
tatra saṃkarṣaṇo devo vibhurāste surā'surāḥ .. 59 ..
1.6.d:
सुरासमुद्रमध्ये तु द्वीपः परमविस्तृतः ॥
तत्र संकर्षणो देवो विभुरास्ते सुराऽसुराः ॥ 59 ॥
1.6.m: In the midst of the Ocean of Wine is an extremely vast island. / There sits the omnipresent god Saṃkarṣaṇa, [worshiped by] gods and asuras.

1.6.s:
upatiṣṭhanti tatrainaṃ divyastisro manoramāḥ ..
kāntiśca madirā caiva tathā devī karīṣiṇī ..1.6.60..
1.6.d:
उपतिष्ठन्ति तत्रैनं दिव्यस्तिस्रो मनोरमाः ॥
कान्तिश्च मदिरा चैव तथा देवी करीषिणी ॥1.6.60॥
1.6.m: There three charming divine [goddesses] attend upon him: / Kānti, Madirā, and the goddess Karīṣiṇī.

1.6.s:
tatrasthamenaṃ paśyanti prajānāṃ patayaḥ sadā..
kṣmāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamidaṃ tavoktaṃ kṣmāpālavṛndāmbarapūrṇacandra ..
samāsato vyāsagirāmaśakyaṃ vaktuṃ mahendropi na varṣapūgaiḥ .. 61 ..
1.6.d:
तत्रस्थमेनं पश्यन्ति प्रजानां पतयः सदा॥
क्ष्मामण्डलं कृत्स्नमिदं तवोक्तं क्ष्मापालवृन्दाम्बरपूर्णचन्द्र ॥
समासतो व्यासगिरामशक्यं वक्तुं महेन्द्रोपि न वर्षपूगैः ॥ 61 ॥
1.6.m: The lords of creatures always behold him dwelling there. / This entire orb of the earth has been told to you in brief, O full moon in the sky of the assembly of kings—a matter which even Mahendra, through the words of Vyāsa, could not tell in heaps of years.

1.7.s:
vajra uvāca ..
jambūdvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ vistareṇa mahāmune . ..
tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi yatra jāto'si bhārgava 41 ..
1.7.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
जम्बूद्वीपस्य संस्थानं विस्तरेण महामुने ॥।
त्वत्तोहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यत्र जातोऽसि भार्गव 41 ॥
1.7.m: Vajra said: / O great sage, I wish to hear from you in detail the layout of Jambūdvīpa, / where you were born, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.7.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
avagāḍhāvubhayatassamudrau pūrvapaścimau ..
jambūdvīpe mahārāja ṣaḍime kulaparvatāḥ .. 2 ..
1.7.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अवगाढावुभयतस्समुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ ॥
जम्बूद्वीपे महाराज षडिमे कुलपर्वताः ॥ 2 ॥
1.7.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Plunging into both oceans, the eastern and western, / there are these six clan mountains in Jambūdvīpa, O great king:

1.7.s:
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca ..
meruśca śṛṃgavāṃścaiva sarve ratnākarāḥ śubhāḥ .. 3 ..
1.7.d:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो नील एव च ॥
मेरुश्च शृंगवांश्चैव सर्वे रत्नाकराः शुभाः ॥ 3 ॥
1.7.m: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, and Nīla, / and Meru and Śṛṅgavān—all auspicious mines of jewels.

1.7.s:
madhye tu maṇḍalaḥ śailo nīlasya niṣadhasya ca ..
sauvarṇaḥ kathyate meruḥ pramāṇaṃ tasya me śṛṇu .. 4 ..
1.7.d:
मध्ये तु मण्डलः शैलो नीलस्य निषधस्य च ॥
सौवर्णः कथ्यते मेरुः प्रमाणं तस्य मे शृणु ॥ 4 ॥
1.7.m: In the middle between Nīla and Niṣadha is the circular mountain; / Meru is said to be made of gold. Hear from me its dimensions.

1.7.s:
caturāśītisāhasrāḥ kathitāścocchrayeṇa ca ..
adhastātṣoḍaśaivoktaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu vistṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
1.7.d:
चतुराशीतिसाहस्राः कथिताश्चोच्छ्रयेण च ॥
अधस्तात्षोडशैवोक्तः षोडशैव तु विस्तृतः ॥ 5 ॥
1.7.m: It is declared to be eighty-four thousand [yojanas] in height; / beneath [the earth] it is stated to be sixteen [thousand], and its breadth is sixteen [thousand].

1.7.s:
vistāro dviguṇaścāsya bhūlagno maṇḍalaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
vṛndapuṣpanibhaścorddhvaṃ dvātriṃśaccaiva vistṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
1.7.d:
विस्तारो द्विगुणश्चास्य भूलग्नो मण्डलः स्मृतः ॥
वृन्दपुष्पनिभश्चोर्द्ध्वं द्वात्रिंशच्चैव विस्तृतः ॥ 6 ॥
1.7.m: Attached to the earth, its diameter is known to be double that, circular in shape. / Resembling an open flower above, it extends thirty-two [thousand].

1.7.s:
vistāro dviguṇaścāsya tatrādhikavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
merustu navatiḥ proktaḥ sahasraḥ pūrvato giriḥ .. 7 ..
1.7.d:
विस्तारो द्विगुणश्चास्य तत्राधिकविधिः स्मृतः ॥
मेरुस्तु नवतिः प्रोक्तः सहस्रः पूर्वतो गिरिः ॥ 7 ॥
1.7.m: Its diameter there is doubled; a larger rule is recognized there. / To the east of Meru, the mountain is declared to be ninety thousand [yojanas].

1.7.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu mālyavān nāma nāmataḥ ..
ānīlaṃ niṣadhaṃ yāvatpaścimena tu tāvatā .. 8 ..
1.7.d:
योजनानां सहस्रं तु माल्यवान् नाम नामतः ॥
आनीलं निषधं यावत्पश्चिमेन तु तावता ॥ 8 ॥
1.7.m: [Its extent is] a thousand yojanas, Mālyavān by name. / Reaching from Nīla to Niṣadha, to the west with an equal measure,

1.7.s:
tāvatpramāṇo nirdiṣṭaḥ pūrvato gandhamādanaḥ ..
merostūttarataḥ śvetaḥ pūrvato'nanta ucyate .. 9 ..
1.7.d:
तावत्प्रमाणो निर्दिष्टः पूर्वतो गन्धमादनः ॥
मेरोस्तूत्तरतः श्वेतः पूर्वतोऽनन्त उच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
1.7.m: gandhamādana is indicated to be of that measure, to the east [and west]. / To the north of Meru is Śveta; to the east it is called Ananta.

1.7.s:
dakṣiṇe ca tathā pītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paścimataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
antareṇa smṛto vipraḥ pūrvataḥ kṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 1.7.10 ..
1.7.d:
दक्षिणे च तथा पीतः कृष्णः पश्चिमतः स्मृतः ॥
अन्तरेण स्मृतो विप्रः पूर्वतः क्षत्रियः स्मृतः ॥ 1.7.10 ॥
1.7.m: And likewise it is yellow to the south, and recorded as black to the west. / In the middle the brahmin is remembered; to the east the kṣatriya is remembered;

1.7.s:
dakṣiṇena tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ paścimataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tasmādudīcī viprāṇāṃ prācī syātkṣattrajanmanām .. 11 ..
1.7.d:
दक्षिणेन तथा वैश्यः शूद्रः पश्चिमतः स्मृतः ॥
तस्मादुदीची विप्राणां प्राची स्यात्क्षत्त्रजन्मनाम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.7.m: likewise the vaiśya to the south; the śūdra is remembered to the west. / Therefore the north belongs to brahmins, the east to those born of kṣatriyas;

1.7.s:
dakṣiṇā vaiśyajātīnāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ paścimā smṛtā ..
prācyāṃ mahendrasya purī merupṛṣṭhe'marāvatī .. 12 ..
1.7.d:
दक्षिणा वैश्यजातीनां शूद्राणां पश्चिमा स्मृता ॥
प्राच्यां महेन्द्रस्य पुरी मेरुपृष्ठेऽमरावती ॥ 12 ॥
1.7.m: the south is remembered for the vaiśya castes, and the west for śūdras. / In the east, on the summit of Meru, is Amarāvatī, the city of Mahendra.

1.7.s:
vahneḥ pradakṣiṇenoktā purī nāmnā sabhāvatī ..
yamasya dakṣiṇenoktā nāmnā saṃyamanī purī .. 13 ..
1.7.d:
वह्नेः प्रदक्षिणेनोक्ता पुरी नाम्ना सभावती ॥
यमस्य दक्षिणेनोक्ता नाम्ना संयमनी पुरी ॥ 13 ॥
1.7.m: To the southeast is declared the city named Sabhāvatī, belonging to Fire; / to the south is declared the city named Saṃyamanī, belonging to Yama.

1.7.s:
proktā vai nairṛtī bhāge purī paścimadakṣiṇe ..
paścimena tathā ramyā sumukhā varuṇasya ca .. 14 ...
1.7.d:
प्रोक्ता वै नैरृती भागे पुरी पश्चिमदक्षिणे ॥
पश्चिमेन तथा रम्या सुमुखा वरुणस्य च ॥ 14 ॥।
1.7.m: In the southwest quarter is declared the city of Nirṛti; / and in the west, delightful Sumukhā belongs to Varuṇa.

1.7.s:
anantaraṃ śivā nāma purī vāyoḥ prakīrtitā ..
