te kṣitau kṣattriyā jātāḥ pīḍayanti tathā kṣamām .. 1.27.20 ..
1.27.d:
त्वत्तेजसा मया दैत्या ये युद्धे विनिपातिताः ॥
ते क्षितौ क्षत्त्रिया जाताः पीडयन्ति तथा क्षमाम् ॥ 1.27.20 ॥
1.27.m: The Daityas who were struck down by me in battle by your splendour / have been born on the earth as kṣatriyas, and thus oppress the earth.

1.27.s:
teṣāṃ bhāreṇa khinneyaṃ tvatsakāśamupāgatā ..
vasudhā vasudhāpāla tāṃ trāyasva namo'stu te .. 21 ..
1.27.d:
तेषां भारेण खिन्नेयं त्वत्सकाशमुपागता ॥
वसुधा वसुधापाल तां त्रायस्व नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 21 ॥
1.27.m: Exhausted by their burden, this earth has approached you. / O protector of the earth, protect her! Homage be to you!

1.27.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ pitāmaho devaḥ stutaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā ..
guruṇā ca sametena pūjayāmāsa tāvubhau .. 22 ..
1.27.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एवं पितामहो देवः स्तुतः शक्रेण धीमता ॥
गुरुणा च समेतेन पूजयामास तावुभौ ॥ 22 ॥
1.27.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus praised by the wise Śakra, accompanied by [his] guru, / the god, the grandfather [of the worlds], honoured them both.

1.27.s:
pūjayitvā ca vasudhāṃ śakraṃ vacanamabravīt ..
vrajadhvaṃ devadevasya śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 23 ..
1.27.d:
पूजयित्वा च वसुधां शक्रं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
व्रजध्वं देवदेवस्य शङ्करस्य महात्मनः ॥ 23 ॥
1.27.m: And having honoured the earth, he spoke these words to Śakra: / "Go to the god of gods, the great-souled Śaṅkara.

1.27.s:
bhuvaścikīrṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayata mā ciram ..
upāyaṃ kṣatriyavadhe yuṣmākaṃ kathayiṣyati .. 24 ..
1.27.d:
भुवश्चिकीर्षितं सर्वं निवेदयत मा चिरम् ॥
उपायं क्षत्रियवधे युष्माकं कथयिष्यति ॥ 24 ॥
1.27.m: Without delay, report all that the earth desires to do. / He will tell you the means for the slaying of the kṣatriyas."

1.27.s:
ityevamuktāstu pitāmahena jagmustadā rudrasadaḥ pratītāḥ ..
śakro'tha devī ca vasundharā ca guruḥ surāṇāñca sa dharmaśīlaḥ .. 25 ..
1.27.d:
इत्येवमुक्तास्तु पितामहेन जग्मुस्तदा रुद्रसदः प्रतीताः ॥
शक्रोऽथ देवी च वसुन्धरा च गुरुः सुराणाञ्च स धर्मशीलः ॥ 25 ॥
1.27.m: Thus addressed by the grandfather, confident they then went to the abode of Rudra: / Śakra, the goddess Earth, and that guru of the gods, steadfast in dharma.

1.28.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
rudralokamathāsādya dadṛśustryambakaṃ tadā ..
vahnipuñjaprakāśena jaṭābhāreṇa rājitam .. 1 ..
1.28.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
रुद्रलोकमथासाद्य ददृशुस्त्र्यम्बकं तदा ॥
वह्निपुञ्जप्रकाशेन जटाभारेण राजितम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.28.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, having reached the world of Rudra, they saw Tryambaka, / resplendent with a mass of matted hair having the radiance of a blazing fire,

1.28.s:
sūryabhāsā tṛtīyena nayanena ca śobhitam ..
bhālacandreṇa śubhreṇa jaṭāmaṇḍalaśobhinā ..2..
1.28.d:
सूर्यभासा तृतीयेन नयनेन च शोभितम् ॥
भालचन्द्रेण शुभ्रेण जटामण्डलशोभिना ॥2॥
1.28.m: adorned with a third eye having the brilliance of the sun, / [and] with the white crescent moon on his forehead, adorning the circle of his matted hair;

1.28.s:
vyālayajñopavītaśca nāgeśvarakṛtāṃśukam ..
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśālākṣadanticarmottaracchadam.. .. 3 ..
1.28.d:
व्यालयज्ञोपवीतश्च नागेश्वरकृतांशुकम् ॥
नीलकण्ठं विशालाक्षदन्तिचर्मोत्तरच्छदम्॥ ॥ 3 ॥
1.28.m: having a serpent as his sacred thread, wearing a garment made of the lord of snakes, / blue-throated, wide-eyed, with an elephant-skin upper garment;

1.28.s:
umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam ..
nandinānugataṃ vīraṃ pramathaiśca sahasraśaḥ .. 4 ..
1.28.d:
उमासहायं वरदं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम् ॥
नन्दिनानुगतं वीरं प्रमथैश्च सहस्रशः ॥ 4 ॥
1.28.m: accompanied by Umā, the giver of boons, the source of the origin of all beings, / attended by Nandin and by thousands of Pramathas,

1.28.s:
nānāvaktraśirogrīvairnānāyudhavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇataḥ prāha śakrastu guruṇā saha .. 5 ..
1.28.d:
नानावक्त्रशिरोग्रीवैर्नानायुधविभूषणैः ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतः प्राह शक्रस्तु गुरुणा सह ॥ 5 ॥
1.28.m: who had diverse faces, heads, and necks, and were adorned with diverse weapons. / Having seen him, Śakra bowed low along with [his] guru and spoke:

1.28.s:
śakra uvāca ..
namo'stu devadeveśa praṇatārtivināśana ..
nīlakaṇṭha mahābhāga hyumābhūṣaṇatatpara .. 6 ..
1.28.d:
शक्र उवाच ॥
नमोऽस्तु देवदेवेश प्रणतार्तिविनाशन ॥
नीलकण्ठ महाभाग ह्युमाभूषणतत्पर ॥ 6 ॥
1.28.m: Śakra said: / "Homage be to the lord of the god of gods, destroyer of the afflictions of those who bow! / O Blue-throated one, O highly fortunate one, devoted to the adornment of Umā!

1.28.s:
gaṅgātaraṅganirdhautajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍita! ..
śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśa sūryakoṭisamaprabha .. 7 ..
1.28.d:
गङ्गातरङ्गनिर्धौतजटामण्डलमण्डित! ॥
शशाङ्कशतसंकाश सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ॥ 7 ॥
1.28.m: O you who are adorned with a circle of matted hair washed by the waves of the Gaṅgā! / O you who resemble a hundred moons, with splendour equal to ten million suns!

1.28.s:
vāmanairjaṭilairmuṇḍaiḥ pramathairīḍyase sadā ..
taiśca sārdhaṃ mahādeva ramase'mitavikrama .. 8 ..
1.28.d:
वामनैर्जटिलैर्मुण्डैः प्रमथैरीड्यसे सदा ॥
तैश्च सार्धं महादेव रमसेऽमितविक्रम ॥ 8 ॥
1.28.m: You are ever praised by the Pramathas—dwarfish, matted-haired, and shaven-headed; / and together with them you delight, O Mahādeva of boundless prowess!

1.28.s:
ghoraṃ hi brahmacaryaṃ te yathā nānyasya kasyacit ..
tava liṅgārcanaratāḥ pūyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..9 ..
1.28.d:
घोरं हि ब्रह्मचर्यं ते यथा नान्यस्य कस्यचित् ॥
तव लिङ्गार्चनरताः पूयन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥9 ॥
1.28.m: Dreadful indeed is your ascetic chastity, such as belongs to no one else. / Those devoted to the worship of your liṅga are cleansed of all sins.

1.28.s:
smaranti ye tvāṃ satataṃ te hi yānti parāṃ gatim ..
viṣṇoracintyabhāgo'si prajāsaṃharaṇe kṛte .. 1.28.10 ..
1.28.d:
स्मरन्ति ये त्वां सततं ते हि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
विष्णोरचिन्त्यभागोऽसि प्रजासंहरणे कृते ॥ 1.28.10 ॥
1.28.m: Those who constantly remember you certainly go to the supreme state. / You are the unthinkable portion of Viṣṇu when the destruction of creatures is performed.

1.28.s:
sarvadevamayo dhātā sarvadevamayo'pi ca ..
sarvadevavareṇyastvaṃ sarvabhūtavibhāvanaḥ ..11..
1.28.d:
सर्वदेवमयो धाता सर्वदेवमयोऽपि च ॥
सर्वदेववरेण्यस्त्वं सर्वभूतविभावनः ॥11॥
1.28.m: You are the creator consisting of all the gods, and you consist of all the gods. / You are the most excellent of all gods, the source of all beings,

1.28.s:
sarvāmaragururdevaḥ sarvabhūteśvareśvaraḥ ..
sarvadevo mahāyogī mahājayo mahābalaḥ .. 12..
1.28.d:
सर्वामरगुरुर्देवः सर्वभूतेश्वरेश्वरः ॥
सर्वदेवो महायोगी महाजयो महाबलः ॥ 12॥
1.28.m: the guru of all immortals, the god, the lord of the lords of all beings, / the all-god, the great yogin, the greatly victorious, possessing great strength,

1.28.s:
mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahātejā mahāyaśāḥ..
catuṣpātsakalo dharmo vāhanaste mahāvṛṣaḥ .. 13 ..
1.28.d:
महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो महातेजा महायशाः॥
चतुष्पात्सकलो धर्मो वाहनस्ते महावृषः ॥ 13 ॥
1.28.m: possessing great intellect, possessing great valor, possessing great majesty, possessing great renown. / Your vehicle is the great bull, the complete four-footed dharma.

1.28.s:
śmaśāne vasatirnityaṃ citādhūmasamākule ..
nṛtyadbhūtākule bhūmerbhūtiśvetānulepanaḥ .. 14 ..
1.28.d:
श्मशाने वसतिर्नित्यं चिताधूमसमाकुले ॥
नृत्यद्भूताकुले भूमेर्भूतिश्वेतानुलेपनः ॥ 14 ॥
1.28.m: Your dwelling is ever in the cremation ground, crowded with the smoke of funeral pyres, / filled with dancing spirits; your white ointment is the ashes of the earth.

1.28.s:
bhūkhārkavarcaḥsalilayajamānenduvāyavaḥ ..
mūrttayaste smṛtā deva yābhirvyāptamidaṃ jagat .. 15 ..
1.28.d:
भूखार्कवर्चःसलिलयजमानेन्दुवायवः ॥
मूर्त्तयस्ते स्मृता देव याभिर्व्याप्तमिदं जगत् ॥ 15 ॥
1.28.m: Earth, space, fire, brilliance, water, the sacrificer, the moon, and the wind: / these are known as your forms, O god, by which this universe is pervaded.

1.28.s:
tvayā vinā jagatyasminnānyatkiñcana vidyate ..
daityabhārābhitaptāṅgāṃ pālayasva namo'stu te .. 16 ..
1.28.d:
त्वया विना जगत्यस्मिन्नान्यत्किञ्चन विद्यते ॥
दैत्यभाराभितप्ताङ्गां पालयस्व नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 16 ॥
1.28.m: Without you, nothing else exists in this universe. / Protect her whose body is tormented by the burden of the Daityas! Homage be to you!"

1.28.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktastu śakreṇa devaḥ śakramabhāṣata ..
kārtavīryamahaṃ tvājau kartā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm .. 17 ..
1.28.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एवमुक्तस्तु शक्रेण देवः शक्रमभाषत ॥
कार्तवीर्यमहं त्वाजौ कर्ता निःक्षत्रियां महीम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.28.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus addressed by Śakra, the god spoke to Śakra: / "I will make the earth bereft of kṣatriyas in battle, but as for Kārtavīrya,

1.28.s:
na śaktastridaśaśreṣṭha yataḥ smartāsmi tadvadham ..
viṣṇudattavaro rājā so'vadhyo mama vāsava .. 18 ..
1.28.d:
न शक्तस्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठ यतः स्मर्तास्मि तद्वधम् ॥
विष्णुदत्तवरो राजा सोऽवध्यो मम वासव ॥ 18 ॥
1.28.m: I am not able, O best of the thirty [gods], to contemplate his slaying, / for, having received a boon from Viṣṇu, that king is invulnerable to me, O Vāsava.

1.28.s:
tameva prārthayiṣyāmi vadhaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ ..
sarve yāta svakaṃ sthānaṃ tvahamapyamareśvaram .. 19 ..
1.28.d:
तमेव प्रार्थयिष्यामि वधं तस्य महात्मनः ॥
सर्वे यात स्वकं स्थानं त्वहमप्यमरेश्वरम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.28.m: I shall pray to him alone for the slaying of that great-souled one. / Go all of you to your own place; I too [shall go] to the lord of the immortals,

1.28.s:
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ yāsye varadamīśvaram ..
viṣṇuścārdhena bhāgena dattātreyo'bhavatkṣitau .. 1.28.20 ..
1.28.d:
चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं यास्ये वरदमीश्वरम् ॥
विष्णुश्चार्धेन भागेन दत्तात्रेयोऽभवत्क्षितौ ॥ 1.28.20 ॥
1.28.m: to the boon-granting Lord who stands within the orb of the moon. / For Viṣṇu, by a half portion, became Dattātreya on earth;

1.28.s: tena dattavaro rājā pālayatyakhilāṃ mahīm .. 21 ..
1.28.d: तेन दत्तवरो राजा पालयत्यखिलां महीम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.28.m: granted a boon by him, the king protects the entire earth."

1.28.s:
ityevamuktastridaśeśvarastu devena sākṣāttripurāntakena ..
jagāma śīghraṃ svapuraṃ praviṣṭo mahīṃ samādāya guruñca rājan .. 22 ..
1.28.d:
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्रिदशेश्वरस्तु देवेन साक्षात्त्रिपुरान्तकेन ॥
जगाम शीघ्रं स्वपुरं प्रविष्टो महीं समादाय गुरुञ्च राजन् ॥ 22 ॥
1.28.m: Thus addressed by the god who was none other than the Destroyer of Tripura, / the lord of the thirty [gods], taking the Earth and [his] guru, O king, quickly went and entered his own city.
